It is worth highlighting the major consequences of the Rules when playing a large number of Automata: they cannot Control Objectives (except with the Cybernetica Trait), cannot make Reactions (except via a cortex controller), can never gain Tactical Statuses (but can gain Cybertheurgic Statuses), and a unit of Automata joined by a Model that can become Routed becomes Routed if it fails a Panic Check at Step 3 of the Resolution Sub-Phase.
<strong>Note de conception.</strong> En: Designer's note. Due to the extreme power of the Lords of War available in the Legio Titanicus army list, it is recommended that these units only be used in battles following the Engine Kill missions. Titans can be included in other missions under the normal rules for selecting Lords of War, or, in very large battles, through an Allied Detachment, but a Titan will most likely dominate the battle, leaving few tactical options to the opponent. In general, if a player wishes to field a Titan outside the Engine Kill missions, it is recommended to warn the opposing player well in advance so they can plan an army able to face such a war engine.

À la différence d’autres détachements ad: Unlike other additional detachments, these detachments are added when certain household rank Prime Advantages are selected for units filling a slot in the Knight Households Primary Detachment, and they are linked to the detachment for which those Prime Slot units were selected (usually the Knight Households Primary Detachment).
À la différence d’autres statuts, le sta: Unlike other statuses, the Disgraced status is automatically removed in the End Phase of the same Player Turn in which it was inflicted, without making a test. À la différence de la Legio Custodes, de: Unlike the Legio Custodes, the Anathema Psykana or the Ruinstorm Daemons, the Blackshields impose no Allegiance: the Allegiance selector in the game settings remains entirely free — Loyalist or Traitor, as you choose.
À la différence des Unités d’autres List: Unlike Units from other Army Lists, those of the Anathema Psykana Army List do not have an optional Allegiance represented by the [Allegiance] Trait, as they always have the Loyalist Trait. As a result, these Units can only be selected in a Loyalist Army — the Allegiance selector in the game settings automatically locks to it as soon as you choose this Faction.

Unlike Units from other Army Lists, those of the Ruinstorm Daemons Army List do not have an optional Allegiance represented by the [Allegiance] Trait, as they always have the Traitor Trait. This is the mirror image of the Anathema Psykana or the Legio Custodes (locked to Loyalist): the Allegiance selector in the game settings automatically locks to Traitor as soon as you choose this Faction.
À la fin d'un Combat, les Figurines ayan: At the end of a Combat, Models with this Special Rule automatically inflict Perils of the Warp on any Unit that includes Models of the Malefic Sub-type or that have the Psyker Trait. If, at the end of Step 5 of the Fight Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase, a Combat involves at least one Model with this Special Rule, all Units (friendly or enemy) in that Combat that include at least one Model of the Malefic Sub-type or with the Psyker Trait immediately suffer the Warp Rupture result on the Perils of the Warp Table. In addition, a Model with this Special Rule is considered to have the Psyker Trait for the purposes of being selected as the Focus of the Nullify Advanced Reaction, as long as at least one Model in the Target Unit is within 12" of the Model with this Special Rule.
À la fin de chacun de ses tours de joueu: At the end of each of their Player Turns, the Attacker chooses a sector in which they have a unit wholly within and scores a number of Victory Points equal to that sector's number. À la fin de la bataille, le vainqueur es: At the end of the battle, the victor is the player who has scored the most Victory Points, from the primary objective or the secondary objectives of the mission played.
À la fin du <strong>tour de bataille 4</: At the end of battle turn 4, the Defender rolls a dice: on a 1 or 2, a fifth battle turn is played before the battle ends; otherwise, the battle ends immediately.

À la fin du <strong>tour de bataille 5</: At the end of battle turn 5, the Defender rolls a dice: on a 1, a sixth battle turn is played before the battle ends; otherwise, the battle ends immediately.
À la fin du tour 4 du joueur, le Défense: At the end of player turn 4, the Defender rolls a dice: on a 4+, a fifth game turn is played before the battle ends.

Alors que Baal est isolé du reste de la: With Baal cut off from the rest of the galaxy, a handful of Sanguinary Terminators, the Colossi, and several thousand legionaries hold the Blood Angels' home world alone. For years, they have fought alongside the Shattered Legions elements that took refuge on Baal, repelling the repeated assaults of the Warmaster's armies. Every fallen Colossus becomes a relic, a symbol and an oath of vengeance.
Alors que la guerre civile de l'Humanité: As Humanity's civil war dragged on, it became ever clearer that the conflict would ultimately be decided on Terra. With this in mind, Rogal Dorn turned his Legion's training towards a defensive posture. Each new warrior was to be one more brick in the defensive bastion of Terra, holding their appointed position unto death. Such warriors were effective, though lacking in initiative — a necessary evil in those dark days.
Alors que la guerre civile progressait,: As the civil war progressed, the Word Bearers' mastery of profane lore became a central pillar of their strategies, unleashing the powers of the Empyrean on their unsuspecting enemies. Marked with runes and diabolic stigmata, their Inductii were regularly exposed to the energies of the Warp, hardening their souls and preparing their bodies for the future enslavement of malevolent warp entities.
Alors que la majorité des Unités Termina: While the majority of Tartaros Terminator Units favoured lighter ranged weapons, this more mobile pattern of Dreadnought Terminator Armour could also be equipped to engage heavier targets such as enemy vehicles and Walkers. Such Units often concentrated the firepower of several Reaper autocannons and plasma blasters to combat these heavily armoured and resilient foes. In other circumstances, these weapons proved invaluable in Zone Mortalis environments, reducing bulkheads and barricades to nothing and allowing these Legionaries to continue their advance unhindered.
Alors que la XVIIe Légion s'enfonçait to: As the XVII Legion delved ever deeper into occult arcana, the Word Bearers' Dark Mechanicum allies adulterated Saturnine plate, among many other technologies, with the profane. The Anointed Phraetus were the first of a new lineage of Saturnine Terminators, replacing several advanced components of their armour with containment systems designed to house a bound daemon, draining the wearer but granting otherworldly power. First devised by elements loyal to Kor Phaeron, the Anointed Phraetus spread rapidly through the XVII Legion as the agents of Lorgar and Erebus uncovered the secrets of their making.
Alors que le coût de la guerre civile ga: As the cost of the galactic civil war mounted, it became necessary to develop expedient solutions to fill the gaps that losses had opened in the Legions' arsenals, or simply to increase the number of troops available in a given region in order to overwhelm the enemy forces operating there. Indomitus pattern Terminator Armour was the fruit of such a compromise, offering neither the outright protection of Cataphractii armour nor the technological advances of the Tartaros pattern, but promising in exchange an abundant supply and less reliance on costly and increasingly scarce resources.
Alors que les escouades tactiques typiqu: While the typical Terran tactical squads, which were like the cogs of well-oiled machinery, became increasingly rare in the VI Legion, the Grey Slayers were, in effect, autonomous warbands on the battlefield.
Alors que les membres des Ofanim étaient: While the members of the Ofanim were accomplished swordsmen, it was in Challenges that their true talent was revealed. While a Model with this Special Rule is engaged in a Challenge, it gains the Duellist's Edge (1) and Feel No Pain (5+) Special Rules.

Amers et tourmentés, obsédés par la mort: Bitter and tormented, obsessed with death and judgement, and convinced of the need to inspire fear in order to control an irredeemably fallible Humanity, Konrad Curze and his Legion were shaped by the terror and darkness of Nostramo as much as by the Emperor's gene-craft. Lurking in the shadows, they wait for the right moment to strike. Amplifiant les cris et grognements du po: Amplifying the screams and snarls of the wearer into dissonant blasts, these weapons stun enemy warriors with high-frequency waves, making them easy prey. When a Unit that includes any Models with sonic shriekers makes a Charge Move, the Target Unit of that Charge cannot make Reactions until the Charge Procedure is complete.
Angron peut livrer plusieurs Défis succe: Angron can fight several successive Challenges in a single Turn. At the start of the Glory Step of a Challenge in which the Challenger is a Model with this Special Rule, before resolving that Glory Step, the Controlling Player of the Model with this Special Rule may immediately return to the Declare Challenge Step in order to declare another Challenge. Enemy Models that have already fought in a Challenge in this Sub-Phase are not eligible to take part in this additional Challenge. When the Glory Step is resolved in this Challenge Sub-Phase, the players gain Combat Resolution Points for all Challenges resolved during this Sub-Phase.
Appareil de recherche et destruction à h: A highly manoeuvrable search-and-destroy craft, the Pallas pattern that equips the Legio Custodes' antigrav attack squadrons provides a strike capability beyond the reach of ground units. Based on the advanced antigravitic repulsion technology pioneered by the Coronus, the Pallas fills a tactical role that exploits its agility to carry out deadly harassing attacks or to hunt down routing foes. Thanks to the superior technology and craftsmanship enjoyed by the Legio Custodes' arsenal, the Pallas is sturdy and endowed with firepower amplified by the martial virtue of its Custodian pilot.
Apparemment subordonnés aux seuls Gardie: Apparently subordinate only to the Keepers of Secrets, the Ascendant Lords lead the hosts of Slaanesh on the front line as generals. Their inclinations are thought to lie in the countless sensory pleasures of war: they crave the thrill of combat and the caress of the blade on living flesh. Whatever the truth of their motivations, these Daemons are deadly warriors — a match even for the Centurions and Praetors of the Legiones Astartes — and seem to possess the experience of many lifetimes, acquired over endless battles.

Après la destruction de Prospero, les Th: After the destruction of Prospero, the Thousand Sons were forced to be less demanding in their recruitment. Experimenting with prohibited bio-alchemy and psychic indoctrination techniques in an attempt to rapidly rebuild their scattered Legion, the resulting Inductii were undoubtedly powerful warriors and sorcerers, but showed a greater susceptibility to the Flesh Change.
Après la traîtrise d'Isstvan III, la ter: After the treachery of Isstvan III, a terrible power seized the Emperor's Children, and for many of Fulgrim's sons the fall was as sudden as it was frightening. One of the first manifestations of this corruption was the creation of psychosonic weapons that were named Cacophony, or "Kakophoni" in its archaic form, powerful but unpredictable instruments of death. The first patterns were used on Isstvan V by Emperor's Children whose moral degeneration was destined to accelerate inexorably over the course of the Horus Heresy.
Après le Massacre de la Zone de Largage,: After the Drop Site Massacre, many Salamanders turned to the Promethean Cult as a source of renewed conviction, including the resurrectionist sect that emerged on Nocturne and the infamous Disciples of the Flame. Known by many names, the most vehement of these "Adherents" formed ad hoc units of fanatical warriors, seemingly with the blessing of their commanding officers. Such cohorts carried their fervour onto countless battlefields, consigning Traitor forces to the flames wherever they could be found, though this restless quest for vengeance made them an unpredictable ally.
Après les événements d'Isstvan V, les ve: After the events of Isstvan V, the scattered remnants of the Salamanders began recruiting on worlds freed from the oppression of the Traitors. These Inductii often received the equipment of Legion warriors who had fallen in battle, accepting both the honour this conferred and the expectations it implied. Gathered under the command of Legion veterans, these new units fought harder still to earn their place.

Armé du redoutable canon à bolts éponyme: Armed with the fearsome bolt cannon from which it takes its name, the Cerastus Knight Castigator is employed by Households against hordes of lesser foes that might overwhelm even a mighty Knight by sheer numbers. It is a formidable combatant, able to annihilate infantry formations under a thundering hail of mass-reactive projectiles, and to carve up light vehicles with ease with blows of its power blade. Among its peers, the Castigator is also renowned for the stern nature of the machine spirits that inhabit it, whose vigour is difficult to awaken but almost impossible to stop.

Arme Psychique de la Discipline Ravissem: Psychic Weapon of the Rapture Discipline (Range 12", Psychic Trait): if a Willpower Check is passed, this attack uses the Characteristics of any weapon in the Target Unit. After selecting the Target Unit of an attack made with a Weapon with this Special Rule, but before any Hit Test, a Willpower Check is made for the attacking Model. If it is failed, the attack ends immediately, and if a double is rolled, the attacking Unit suffers Perils of the Warp. Au sein de la Légion de la Death Guard e: Within the Death Guard Legion existed a cadre of Destroyers equipped with weapons that even the Destroyers of other Legions would have shrunk from bearing. Often used as an act of censure or punishment, assignment to a Mortus Poisoner Squad amounted to a death sentence, the weapons its members carried into battle guaranteeing them a slow and inescapable wasting. Yet there were those within this damned brotherhood who embraced the role with enthusiasm, seeking to come to grips with their enemies and deal them a toxic death with a disturbing disregard for their own longevity.
Au sein de la Première Légion coexistent: Within the First Legion countless Orders coexist, each devoted to a distinct warrior creed. Au sein de la XVe Légion, la responsabil: Within the XV Legion, responsibility for maintaining weaponry, vessels and war machines fell to the Order of Ruin. Its highest-ranking members were commonly called Numerologists and, as well as fulfilling a role similar to that of Techmarines in other Legions, they were also renowned for their remarkable tactical acuity. The archives note that XV Legion battle groups including Numerologists could react to changes of tactical plan with fluid synchronicity, even when separated by hundreds of kilometres, a phenomenon doubtless linked to the practice of the powers that would eventually damn the Thousand Sons. Life Wards — usually deployed with the rear echelons of the XV Legion during the Great Crusade, Numerologists saw far more frequent front-line service during the Horus Heresy. To minimise the risks, they went into battle accompanied by a cadre of specialised Life Wards tasked with protecting them while they went about their duties.
Au sein des Légions, il ne restait que p: Within the Legions, few Scout cohorts remained at the outbreak of the Horus Heresy, most companies equipped with Scout armour having long since been reassigned to reconnaissance Detachments. The rare survivors are often veterans of more than a century of war in the most hostile terrain known to humanity, and the last Pathfinders remain peerless experts in combat in such dangerous environments.

Basé sur la technologie du Coronus, le c: Based on Coronus technology, the Caladius Grav-tank is a fast and sturdy platform that makes the most of the twinned power afforded by the heavy weapons unique to the Legio Custodes' arsenal, in the form of a twin Iliastus accelerator cannon or an Arachnus blaze cannon. Through this fusion of advanced systems and weapons, the Caladius is perhaps the most powerful armoured vehicle of its tonnage among the forces of the Imperium, thanks to technologies and materials inherited from the Dark Age of Technology, but also to developments bequeathed by two centuries of the Great Crusade.
Bâtisseurs increvables, les fils de Roga: Indestructible builders, the sons of Rogal Dorn hold their walls to the last man: retreat is not a word they know.
Beaucoup d'Émissaires Noirs savaient que: Many Black Emissaries knew that spreading the word of the Warmaster would lead them into some of the most dangerous war zones of the Imperium. These warriors took extra care to ensure that their task was carried out, often favouring the additional protection offered by Terminator plate, so that no battlefield and no servant of Horus would be beyond their reach. This Model may be replaced by 1 Tartaros Dark Emissary, for free.
Beaucoup d'Inductii des Blood Angels ne: Many Blood Angels Inductii saw nothing of the beauty of combat their Legion brothers spoke of, knowing only the horror of galactic civil war. Lacking the intensive mental conditioning that restrained the most animal aspects of their gene-heritage, these warriors were often the dark reflection of their angelic brothers.
Beaucoup pensaient les Space Wolves indi: Many thought the Space Wolves individualists incapable of discipline and cohesion, but nothing could be further from the truth. Their tactics demanded supreme coordination, and each warrior's thirst for glory came second to the needs of the pack. These traits were all embodied in the Jorlund Hunter Packs. Swift and agile, they fell upon the enemy lines, driving their foes before them with roaring torrents of fire. Those not consumed by the flames were cut down by the howling Hunter Packs as they moved on to their next target. Scouring Tempest — guided by unshakeable faith in the auguries of the war-seers, the Jorlund Hunter Packs accompany the VI Legion's vanguard forces and run ahead of the battle line to incinerate their enemies with purifying flame. Bénéficiant d'un accès complet à l'arsen: Enjoying full access to their Legion's arsenal through the Rite of Command, Consul-Delegatus take the field in a myriad of wargear configurations, and where haste or crossing difficult terrain matter above all else, bikes and jetbikes offer mobility unmatched for their size.

Bien que chaque Excindio soit habituelle: Although each Excindio is usually kept under technological restraint, in battle these restrictions must be loosened to unleash its full power. If it is sufficiently damaged, however, even the strict safeguards imposed by its controllers can be overridden by its complex adaptive systems. The resulting fury is as dangerous to its allies as to its enemy, until it can be brought back under control. While a Model with this Special Rule has a Current Wounds Characteristic of 4 or less, in each of its Controlling Player's Shooting Phases it must make a Shooting Attack targeting the closest friendly or enemy Unit that has Line of Sight to the Model. Such a Shooting Attack must use all Weapons that are in range of at least one Model in the Target Unit.
Bien que désigné officieusement Escouade: Though unofficially designated the Effrit Stealth Squad, the reality of the organisation and role of this elite echelon of the XX Legion is far more complex and defies simple convention. Such detachments, made up of highly capable individuals chosen for their innate aptitude for stealth, subterfuge and reconnaissance, are tasked with perilous missions on the battlefield, from the close observation of enemy commanders to disruptive strikes against vulnerable war machines. In this role, they are frequently infiltrated behind enemy lines for months, with little more equipment than lone Legionaries can carry. Hydra's Wail — projected from disruption arrays entrusted to elite advanced infiltration teams, the Howls of the Hydra are a suite of targeted waves and disruptive signals across a multitude of frequencies. Using systems believed to be derived from proscribed Abominable Intelligences dating from the Dark Age of Technology, these emissions can overwhelm enemy communications, scanning and coordination networks, which, unless specifically countered, renders whole swathes of the Legion's standard equipment unusable.
Bien que peu enclins à la guerre hauteme: Although little inclined to the highly manoeuvrable warfare favoured by the White Scars, there are many instances where the heavier armour and greater protection of Terminator plate are the only viable option for the Legion's Stormseers.

Capitaine de la 10e Compagnie, Nouvelle: Captain of the 10th Company, New Moon of the Mournival, The Last Wolf of Luna. Garviel Loken was one of the captains of the Luna Wolves Legion (later the Sons of Horus) during the final years of the Great Crusade. Admired by his battle-brothers and his Primarch alike, he had the honour of being admitted to the Mournival, the close counsellors of Horus himself. After Horus' fall, Loken was deemed too loyal to the Emperor and was placed at the head of the Sons of Horus in the assault on Isstvan III.
Capitaine de la 10e Compagnie. Saul Tarv: Captain of the 10th Company. Saul Tarvitz was an Emperor's Children company captain respected by his subordinates and able to boast a considerable number of victories. However, he was content to be a line officer, serving his Legion on the battlefield, and lacked the ambition that drove many of his comrades. When he discovered the extent of the treachery on Isstvan III, Tarvitz took the initiative and headed for the surface of the doomed world to warn the Loyalists trapped on the ground of the imminent massacre and to aid them in the battle to come.
Capitaine de la 18e Compagnie, « Soit l': Captain of the 18th Company, "Either", Hunter of the Iron Heart. Charged with hunting down the survivors of the Drop Site Massacre on Isstvan V, Marr was behind the destruction of the Iron Hands' Clan Council on Oqueth Minor. He pursued his hunt for three years, and came to respect Shadrak Meduson as much as he hated him.
Capitaine de la 405e Compagnie des Imper: Captain of the 405th Company of the Imperial Fists, The Crimson Fist.
Capitaine de la 456e Compagnie des Imper: Captain of the 456th Company of the Imperial Fists, The Tyrant of Cthonia.
Capitaine de la 94e Compagnie, Le Tisseu: Captain of the 94th Company, The Shroud Weaver.
Capitaine de la Huitième Compagnie d'Ass: Captain of the Eighth Assault Company, The Twice-Survived, The Exterminator.
Capitaine du Conqueror, Une Rose Baignée: Captain of the Conqueror, A Rose Bathed in Blood.
Capitaine-Général de la Legio Custodes,: Captain-General of the Legio Custodes, the Emperor's Shield, Magisterium Ultima. Constantin Valdor stands at the right hand of the Emperor, whose most faithful companion he is, watching over him with unwavering devotion and martial prowess all but unequalled. The latter, combined with Valdor's physical and mental abilities, has led him to be described in hushed tones at the Imperial Court as the "unacknowledged Primarch". It is a fallacious claim, for however mighty he may be, Valdor plays a less ambitious role, that of Lord Commander of the Custodian Guard. To Valdor, glory and conquest, dominion and victory, are but petty childishness compared to the duty he has sworn to fulfil. Thus, although Constantin Valdor's rank places him in some respects above even the Primarchs, and he is at the heart of Imperial power on Terra, he rarely exercises his influence, save in matters that concern him directly, and never in the service of any personal ambition whatsoever. But should his role be called into question, or worse, should the Emperor or His representatives be threatened, Valdor would become a demigod of vengeance: invincible and relentless.

Caste distincte des Démons mineurs connu: A distinct caste of the lesser Daemons known as Daemonettes, the Seekers of Slaanesh seem to have much in common with the latter; however, they choose, or are ordered by their masters, to ride into battle on bipedal reptilian steeds. One can only guess why these Daemons cooperate thus, when other forms receive wings or entirely unnatural means of flight, but it is evident that these mounts lend speed to the advance of these vile servants of suffering.
Cavaliers de Chogoris, les fils de Jagha: Riders of Chogoris, the sons of Jaghatai Khan strike with the speed of the wind and leave the enemy nothing but the dust of their passing.

Ce livre contient des Règles additionnel: This book contains additional Rules for Solar Auxilia tied to one of the eighteen Space Marine Legions. Each Legiones Auxilia Designation describes a themed Advanced Reaction, usable in place of an existing Reaction by Solar Auxilia Armies that select it — restricted to a Primary Detachment in which no Model has any [Legiones Astartes] Trait other than that of the stated Legion (full text in Special Rules). The "Legiones Auxilia Designation" menu in the game settings lets you choose yours — this choice is optional and is not automatically checked against the composition of your Primary Detachment.
Ce Modèle peut échanger sa bombarde à pl: This Model may exchange its plasma bombard for a twin heavy disintegrator
Ce petit bouclier n'offre à lui seul guè: This small shield offers little protection on its own, but it projects complex energy fields that diffract and weaken the radiation and kinetic energy aimed at its bearer. These directional fields cover a relatively small area, which requires the buckler to be angled precisely, a difficult feat for any but the Legio Custodes. The Firepower of attacks made as part of a Volley Attack or an Overwatch Reaction is modified by -1 when resolving Wound Tests against a Unit that includes at least one Model equipped with a Tarsus Buckler.

Ce système défensif est considéré comme: This defensive system is regarded as archaic and temperamental by most Tech-priests, but remains in use on older vehicles — such as the Macrocarid. It uses a bank of electrochemical capacitors to generate a powerful electromagnetic shock pulse across the vehicle's hull. A Vehicle with this Special Rule inflicts more Damage when it moves through enemy Units. When a Model with this Special Rule and the Vehicle Type moves through an enemy Unit, the number of Hits inflicted is increased from D6 to D3+3. These Hits have the Stun (1) Special Rule. In addition, if the Reactive Player declares a Death or Glory Reaction targeting a Model with this Special Rule, that Model gains a 6+ Invulnerable Save against all Hits inflicted by that Reaction.
Celui qui est Plusieurs, L'Assassin. Nul: The One Who Is Many, the Assassin. No one knows whether Exodus is a single individual or several assassins. In any case, the name, or at least the codename "Exodus", has appeared in numerous transcripts of vox messages and order archives across several theatres of operations, sometimes simultaneously. This can hardly be an error, given the Alpha Legion's mastery of deception in all its forms. Whatever the case, Exodus is so skilled that some claim he surpasses even the snipers of the Vindicare Clade in his ability to infiltrate an enemy position and deliver a fatal shot at the most decisive moment of a campaign.
Certaines Armes de grande taille utilise: Some large Weapons use a different Template instead of the standard Flamer Template (for example the Hellstorm Template, given in brackets after "Template").
Certaines cases de l’organigramme porten: Some slots in the chart bear a special symbol: these are Prime Slots. They grant a benefit: a Prime Advantage of your choice from the 5 below, plus 2 specific to the Legio Custodes detailed at the end of the list. Most are characteristic upgrades… except one, which is very strong for structuring your list.

Certaines cohortes de guerriers prennent: Some cohorts of warriors take to the battlefield with a specific target marked for destruction. Such actions may be driven by a desire for vengeance, to settle a dispute, or simply result from the express orders of their superiors in the interest of a wider strategy. At the end of the Mission's Declare Reserves Step, the Controlling Player of any Unit with this Special Rule may choose a Unit in the Opposing Player's Army: that Unit becomes the "Marked" Unit. Once per Battle, the Controlling Player scores additional Victory Points equal to the value of X if a friendly Unit with this Special Rule scores Victory Points through the Vanguard (X) Special Rule when the enemy Unit that fulfils the conditions of the Vanguard (X) Special Rule is the Marked Unit.
Certaines Figurines peuvent employer des: Some Models can use Cybertheurgic abilities to afflict Units with a special Status, called a Cybertheurgic Status, by Invoking a Cybertheurgic Rite. Only a Model with the Cybertheurgist Trait can know and Invoke a Cybertheurgic Rite, and a Model can only Invoke one per Battle Turn (more with the Controller (X) Special Rule).
Certaines figurines peuvent puiser dans: Some models can draw on the power of the Warp to attack, support their allies or hinder the enemy. There are three families of psychic abilities: psychic weapons, psychic powers and psychic reactions. All of them require the model to have the Psyker trait.
Certaines Légions font de la vitesse leu: Some Legions make speed their absolute priority, and their warriors are accustomed to going into battle on swift Scimitar Jetbikes. For many command squads, such a mount is not an operational necessity but a preference of the commander they accompany. Far from seeing it as a disadvantage, they instead seize these opportunities to hone their skills: able to switch rapidly from a stationary position, providing fire support with its heavy weapons, to a high-speed charge into the heart of the enemy forces, the Scimitar Jetbike offers unmatched flexibility in the performance of their duty.
Certaines réactions psychiques n’appliqu: Some psychic reactions do not apply the Blessing/Curse rules below and describe their own effect directly — this is the case for Nullify, which lets a Psyker counter an opponent's Curse (see the Statuses & Reactions page).
Certaines règles donnent des réactions s: Some rules grant additional Reactions, for example the Primary Detachment of the Legiones Astartes, Legio Custodes, Solar Auxilia, Questoris Knight, and the 'Master of the Legion' rule (Praetor, certain characters).
Certains adeptes du Mechanicum ne reconn: Some adepts of the Mechanicum did not recognise the limits imposed by the doctrine of the Omnissiah: this book describes two categories of Units for such armies, restricted to the Traitor Allegiance.
Certains chars peuvent recevoir l’amélio: Some tanks can receive the Legion Decurion upgrade: a seasoned tank commander, represented by a model visible in an otherwise unoccupied cupola or hatch. The army book offers 4, restricted to the Predator, Sicaran (only with the standard twin accelerator autocannon or the Punisher rotary cannon) and Kratos Assault Tank; a fifth, the Decurion Magna, comes from the Journal Tactica Mailed Fist and applies to Fellblade and Falchion super-heavy tanks. Only one Decurion upgrade per Model, and two of them are restricted to a specific Legion.
Certains cultistes sont si dévoués aux P: Some cultists are so devoted to the Ruinous Powers that they regard even the most monstrously Warp-corrupted among their number as blessed paragons whom they must guide along the righteous path. A Model with this Special Rule may join Units with the Malefic Sub-type as if it had that Sub-type; while it is part of such a Unit, it is treated as having that Sub-type.
Certains Démons mineurs se manifestent a: Some lesser Daemons manifest with wings sprouting from their backs, granting them the power of flight across the battlefield. Such creatures provide a form of air support to the Ruinstorm hordes, swooping down from the skies to snatch isolated warriors or overwhelm defensive positions with their numbers. Bat-like wings or avian pinions are the most common forms of flight, but others take the form of monstrous insects or creatures that defy all logic, gliding without any visible means of propulsion.
Certains Démons prennent des formes qui: Some Daemons take forms that seem to parody the cavalry of mortal armies of old, or that recall the myths of centaurs. They often harass the enemy's flanks, hunting down stragglers while the bulk of the daemonic horde occupies the rest of the opposing forces. The cavalry of the daemonic hordes is as varied as their troops on foot, from agile steeds to vast lumbering juggernauts, by way of centaur-like creatures and lesser Daemons mounted on armoured monstrosities. Whatever their appearance, they are swift and deadly, often bursting from the Warp to strike before their prey is ready.

Some Daemons take forms that are sinister parodies of the predatory life teeming across the galaxy. Like packs of hunting hounds, these creatures race ahead of the horde as scouts, tracking their prey wherever it hides; once found, the beasts tear it apart with fangs, claws and horns. Their howls draw the others, directing the daemonic horde to where the fighting is fiercest.
Certains Diabolistes revêtent l'Armure T: Some Diabolists don Terminator Armour to accompany the most perilous assaults of the Word Bearers, carrying their rites of damnation into the very heart of the melee.
Certains engins sont conçus pour être tr: Some machines are designed to be easily carried aboard the various armoured carriers available to the Imperium — some are flexible enough to pass through hatches intended for smaller creatures, others are designed to fold into a compact transport mode, or are simply small in size. A Model with this Special Rule may Embark on or Disembark from a Transport even if its Type would normally prevent it. A Model with this Special Rule may Embark on and Disembark from a Model with the Transport Sub-type as if it had the Infantry Type. This does not replace its existing Type nor grant it any other benefit of the Infantry Type, and does not allow it to interact with other Rules or Special Rules that target or affect the Infantry Type.
Certains Ésotéristes étudient le Warp da: Some Esoterists study the Warp for the sole purpose of discovering the weaknesses of the entities that lurk within it. Others see them as highly convenient tools for securing victory, devoid of loyalty or intentions of their own. A Model with the Anathemata Discipline gains the Fear (1) Special Rule, the Void Darts Psychic Weapon and the "Anathemata" Trait; if it has the Loyalist Trait, it may use the Seal the Veil Psychic Reaction, and if it has the Traitor Trait, the Tear the Veil Psychic Power.
Certains Forgeguerres préféraient la mob: Some Warsmiths preferred the mobility offered by lighter armour to that of their brothers clad in Terminator plate. No less gifted for it, these warriors were just as capable of assessing a fortification and bringing it down. This Model counts as a Warsmith Model for the selection of The Hammer of Olympia Apex Detachment.
Certains guerriers sont spécifiquement e: Some warriors are specifically trained in the execution of broader strategies, trusted to coordinate their fellows under the direction of their commander. This Special Rule allows the Controlling Player to reduce the Reaction Point cost of a Reaction, once per Turn. Once per Turn, if a Unit that includes at least one Model with this Special Rule is within 18" of a Unit making a Reaction, the Controlling Player may make an Intelligence Check for that Unit. If a Model in the Unit with this Special Rule has Line of Sight to a Model in the Reacting Unit, the Controlling Player may modify the result of that Check by -1. If the Check is passed, that Reaction costs one fewer Reaction Point (to a minimum of 0).
Certains profils d’arme sont signalés pa: Some weapon profiles are marked with a *. When a player chooses this weapon, they may only use these profiles if they have selected the corresponding Wargear option.
Certains Rites ou Statuts Cybertheurgiqu: Some Cybertheurgic Rites or Statuses inflict Cybertheurgic Feedback on a Unit: each Model suffers 1 Wound with an AP of "-" and a Damage of 1, with no Wound Test and no Cover/Invulnerable Save (Armour Saves are allowed). A Model with the Vehicle Type suffers only a single Glancing Hit per Cybertheurgic Feedback, with no Armour Penetration Test.
Certains spécialistes s'entraînent aux s: Some specialists train in battlefield medicine and carry dedicated equipment, from a simple satchel of dressings and painkillers to the complex devices borne by Legion Apothecaries. If they manage to reach a wounded warrior in time, such fighters can return them to the fight. This Special Rule sets the difficulty of any Recovery Test granted by another Special Rule, Reaction or Ability — it does not allow a Recovery Test by itself, it only sets the Target Number when another source (for example the Medic! Advanced Reaction) allows one. A Recovery Test is made when one or more Unsaved Wounds are allocated to a Model: roll a dice and compare it to the value of X; if successful, a single Unsaved Wound allocated to the Model has its Damage reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0). Medic! Advanced Reaction: the Reactive Player may declare it in Step 9 of any Shooting Attack if the Target Unit of that Shooting Attack includes one or more Models with the Medic (X) Special Rule (Cost: 1 Reaction Allotment, paid on declaration; Target: the Target Unit of the Shooting Attack that triggers the Reaction). Once this Advanced Reaction has been declared, the Active Player continues to resolve that Shooting Attack as normal; in Step 11, the Reactive Player may make a Recovery Test for each Model in the Target Unit that is allocated an Unsaved Wound — no more than one Recovery Test per Model, and none for a Model that itself has the Medic (X) Special Rule.
Ces Armes possèdent à la fois un profil: These Weapons have both a Ranged and a Melee profile (see Melee Weapons below).
These Weapons have both a Ranged and a Melee profile (see Ranged Weapons above).
Ces créatures ressemblent extérieurement: These creatures outwardly resemble the automata of the Mechanicum, but beneath their metal skin they have nothing in common with them. The Artificia are not crude metal servitors, but a living mind forged in steel and conditioned to hate every other form of life. Models with the Artificia Type cannot gain any Cybertheurgic Status, but can gain Tactical Statuses or other types of Status effects. When targeting a Unit that includes Models with the Artificia Type, the Poisoned (X) Special Rule is only triggered on a Wound Test result of "6" before modifiers are applied, regardless of the value of X of that variant of the Special Rule.
Ces dispositifs sont amorcés avec des do: These devices are primed with low-grade djinn-data and other aggressive but ephemeral code-spirits. Once released into a system, they swarm its cogitator nodes, temporarily delaying the deployment of security protocols and allowing the operator to manipulate the host freely. Combat decryptors allow Models to interact with Zone Mortalis Special Rules and Advanced Reactions: a Unit that includes at least one Model equipped with a Combat decryptor may use the Bypass Cogitator (X) Special Rule as if that Model had the Battlesmith (X) Special Rule; in addition, during an Interface Check, a Model equipped with a Combat decryptor is considered to have a base Intelligence Characteristic of 9.

Ces êtres impies étaient créés à partir: These unholy beings were created from corrupted Contemptor Dreadnought chassis, whose blackened armour melted like wax to spew black flames. Certain religious writings name them "Mhara Gal", a Colchisian allegory that might be translated as "That which was blessed, but has now failed in its vows to the Eightfold Path" and received "life beyond death as punishment".
Ces objectifs secondaires sont toujours: These secondary objectives are always in play in a Leviathan mission, but their value varies from one mission to another. Some are listed for only one player: only that player can then score them.
Ces règles ne s’appliquent que dans les: These rules only apply in the missions that list them; they replace certain aspects of the core rules or add new options.
Ces règles s’appliquent aux <strong>troi: These rules apply to the three Leviathan missions below, as well as to the legendary mission The Charge of the Khalekaorus: read them once, they are not repeated on each card.
Ces règles s’appliquent aux deux mission: These rules apply to the two missions Clash of Iron and Reconnaissance in Force: read them once, they are not repeated on each card.
Ces règles s’utilisent en conjonction av: These rules are used in conjunction with the Armies of the Age of Darkness rules (Warhammer: The Horus Heresy — Age of Darkness rulebook, p. 278); the Solar Auxilia use the same Crusade Force Organisation Chart as the Legiones Astartes (Primary Detachment, standard Auxiliary/Apex Detachments, same Battlefield Roles).
Ces reliques portables datant de l'Âge d: These portable relics dating from the Age of Strife allow a small group of warriors to teleport without a full teleportarium or the targeting equipment and protective fields normally required for such a perilous manoeuvre. They are, however, notorious for their tendency to malfunction if the slightest error is made in their calibration: hence only the most reckless or vainglorious commanders sanction their use in battle. A Model equipped with an aetheric junction splicer has the Deep Strike Special Rule. While such a Model has joined, in Reserves, a Unit that includes only Models with the [Legiones Astartes] Trait, the Infantry Type and no variant of the Bulky (X) Special Rule where X is greater than 2, all Models in that Unit also gain the Deep Strike Special Rule. In addition, when a Unit that includes one or more Models equipped with an aetheric junction splicer suffers one or more Unsaved Wounds as a result of the Intercept Advanced Reaction, that Unit immediately gains the Suppressed Tactical Status.
Ces sinistres guerriers étaient les yeux: These sinister warriors were the eyes of the Warmaster, recruited from among the Legionaries most devoted to his cause and dispatched to the stars to oversee and guide the forces that swore allegiance to Horus. They were charged with setting an example by showing what the Warmaster expected of his followers and mercilessly executing those who failed. Their presence was an omen of victory for the Traitors.
Ces trois réactions avancées sont ouvert: These three Advanced Reactions are available to any unit made up solely of models with the Knight sub-type, whatever its household paradigm — in addition to each household's own Advanced Reaction.
Ces trois règles générales s’appliquent: These three general rules apply to the three Onslaught missions below: read them once, they are not repeated on each mission sheet.
Ces véhicules ne sont pas destinés au co: These vehicles are not intended for front-line combat, but serve as demolition tools to bring down buildings or fortifications that would hinder the advance of friendly forces; in the most extreme situations they can be employed as weapons, but remain vulnerable to enemy fire. Vehicles with this Special Rule may make Charges and inflict automatic Hits on every Model in a Combat if successful. A Model with this Special Rule and the Vehicle Type may have a Charge declared for it in the Assault Phase. If a Charge Roll made for this Model fails, it is Removed as a Casualty, but immediately explodes as described by its Explodes (X) Special Rule. If the Charge Roll succeeds, then at the end of Step 2 of the Fight Sub-Phase, each Unit in that Combat suffers a number of automatic Hits equal to the number of Models in that Unit, each at Strength 8, AP "-", Damage 2, with the Armourbane Special Rule. Once these Hits have been fully resolved, the Model with this Special Rule is immediately Removed as a Casualty, and any variant of the Explodes (X) Special Rule it has is ignored.

The Caestus pattern Assault Ram is a massively built block of armour, designed to carry out boarding actions against enemy starships, using its forward-firing magna-melta cannon and then its reinforced superstructure to smash through the enemy's hull armour, before delivering its cargo of Legiones Astartes directly aboard the enemy vessel. Revelations from the discoveries of Arkhan Land allowed this venerable pattern to be augmented, enabling it to be used in high-velocity direct orbital drops, as well as to operate as a heavy armoured patrol craft in support of ground operations in extremis.

Created as a super-heavy assault shuttle for the Legio Custodes, the Enyalas pattern Orion can carry several Sodalities of Custodians into battle and support their attack with deadly salvoes. Protected by frontal armour superior to that of any other craft of its size, the Orion has a twin Arachnus blaze cannon capable of shredding Flyers and armoured vehicles alike, as well as a combination of Spiculus pods and Lastrum bolt cannons to clear the zone where it drops off its warriors, before taking off again to rain death on any foe who dares approach.

The Legio Custodes' use of antigrav craft gave its forces a degree of flexibility and speed beyond the reach of the ponderous armoured units of the Imperium's other forces, allowing them to deploy, redeploy and withdraw without risk of being pinned in place by enemy troops or broken terrain. The Coronus Grav-carrier is doubtless the best-known example, at once the main transport of the Legio's Sodalities and the template for the later Enyalas antigrav craft, providing the Legio Custodes with its exclusive arsenal of highly sophisticated armoured vehicles.

The Land Raider Achilles shares most of its STC with the Phobos pattern Land Raider, with the notable exception that it sacrifices much of its transport capacity to mount a quad launcher, a weapon most often employed as a mobile artillery piece. The glacis of the Land Raider Achilles also bears layer upon layer of ancient electromagnetic incantations, and ferromantic computational algorithms are etched into every part of its structure at a microscopic scale. The resulting armour offers increased resilience against damage that would threaten to immobilise this mighty war machine.

Chevalier Errant, ancien Capitaine de la: Knight Errant, former Captain of the Death Guard 7th Battle Company, Hand of the Sigillite. Although Nathaniel Garro served Mortarion with devotion during the Great Crusade, his unwavering loyalty to the Emperor was well known, and that is why, alongside many of his brothers, he was marked for elimination at Isstvan III. Escaping this trap aboard the frigate Eisenstein, it was Garro's warning to the Imperium that forced the Warmaster to abandon his lightning invasion of the Throneworld and undertake a grinding advance instead. Having renounced his oaths to his Primarch, Garro knelt before the Sigillite, swearing to undertake any mission required, however perilous, for the ultimate defence of humanity.
Chevalier Errant, ancien Codicier des Ul: Knight Errant, former Codicier of the Ultramarines. Tylos Rubio was the first to be recruited into the Knights-Errant by Nathaniel Garro, who managed to reach Calth at the very moment of the Word Bearers' betrayal during the Battle of Calth. Forced by the circumstances of that fighting to use his psychic powers, which he had abjured in accordance with the Edict of Nikaea, Rubio saw his brothers-in-arms turn their backs on him, and he agreed to join Garro and return with him to Terra. By once again donning a psychic hood and taking up his force sword, his ability to counter the powers of the Warp would prove as precious to the Sigillite's cause as a thousand bolters.
Chevaliers de Caliban, les fils du Lion: Knights of Caliban, the sons of the Lion guard a secret heavier than their swords: that of the Fallen Brothers they hunt without rest.

Few in number, they are those who have proven their valour during the Hunting Parties, the exercises the Legio Custodes organises to test the weak points of the Emperor's personal defences, and who have the talent to use the flight equipment and archeotech armament of the Venatari. The rooftops and spires of the Imperial Palace are their domain, as is the airspace during the Legio Custodes' assaults, from which they assess threats on the ground before swooping down on them from their eyries on Terra or the hold of a Flyer.

Autilon Skorr was frequently dispatched to demand the Compliance of newly discovered worlds in the name of the Imperium. Worlds that refused invariably sank into disorder within weeks, and ended up capitulating. After the outbreak of the Horus Heresy, Skorr continued to play this role, until the debacle of Epsilon-Stranivar IX, where the disparate forces of a dozen Loyalist battle groups drove back his forces. Skorr's prestige was tarnished, and he quickly fell from favour with both the Warmaster and his Primarch. Desperate to regain his past glory, he seized upon the Mezoa campaign as a chance for redemption. On rare occasions, groups of these Chieftains were gathered to fight alongside their overlord, temporarily setting aside their command duties for the honour of watching over a hero of the Legion and bearing his banner into battle. Honour Above All — the Chieftains of the Sons of Horus had earned their rank through loyalty, honour and merciless violence, their devotion and quality tested against countless foes without ever being found wanting. Des décennies durant, les techniques méd: For decades, the medical techniques by which a psyker's powers could be preserved through the half-life of incarceration within a Dreadnought sarcophagus eluded the Legiones Astartes. Only when Magnus himself turned his attention to the matter did he find a solution, difficult though it was. He devised the use of a psychometric barrier placed around the organic brain of the mortally wounded psyker, which he named the "Osiron". The Thousand Sons immediately adapted these delicate devices to the Contemptor Dreadnought chassis in their possession, with excellent results.

Deux familles de gabarits mesurent certa: Two families of templates are used to measure certain Weapon effects instead of a tape measure. Blast Markers (circular, in several sizes) are placed at a distance from the attacking Model and then scatter to their final position (see Blast (X)). Template markers (teardrop-shaped) are placed with the narrow end touching the Base of the attacking Model and never scatter (see Template). In both cases, a Model is "under" the template if its Base (or Hull) is even partially covered, holding the template parallel to the Battlefield to judge this.

Développement de l'armure Terminator mod: A development of the Legiones Astartes' Cataphractii pattern Terminator Armour, the Aquilon pattern takes account of the physique of the members of the Legio Custodes, and incorporates additional power systems to compensate for the limitations of the original pattern. Sodalities of Aquilon Terminators were only mustered in cases of pressing need, such as the rare occasions when Custodians operated in so-called "Zone Mortalis" conditions. The Legio, anxious to minimise its losses, then relied on the superior protection of Aquilon Terminator Armour and its qualities as a mobile firing platform.

Doctrine de Cohorte axée sur l'artilleri: Cohort Doctrine focused on heavy artillery. Models with the Solar Auxilia Trait in an Army that adheres to this Doctrine improve by +1 the value of X of the Pinning (X) Special Rule on their Weapons with the Barrage (X) Special Rule, and on any Weapon with both Barrage (X) and Pinning (X). Unlocks, for each Artillery Tercio Auxiliary Detachment on the Army Roster, an additional Artillery Tercio Auxiliary Detachment without using a Command Slot.
Doctrine de Cohorte axée sur l'assaut dé: Cohort Doctrine focused on mounted assault. Models with the Solar Auxilia Trait and the Vanguard (X) Special Rule in an Army that adheres to this Doctrine do not make a Charge declared for a Unit composed entirely of such Models Disordered in the Player Turn in which it Disembarks from a Dracosan. Unlocks, for each Veletaris Tercio Auxiliary Detachment on the Army Roster, an additional Veletaris Tercio Auxiliary Detachment without using a Command Slot.
Doctrine de Cohorte axée sur la masse d': Cohort Doctrine focused on massed infantry. Models with the Solar Auxilia Trait in an Army that adheres to this Doctrine follow the Coordinated Manoeuvres Special Rule: in each Movement, Shooting and Assault Phase, the first Reaction declared whose Reacting Unit is a Lasrifle Section has its Reaction Point cost modified by -1 (to a minimum of 0), and a Lasrifle Section may make one additional Reaction per Phase for one fewer Reaction Allotment. Unlocks, for each Infantry Tercio Auxiliary Detachment on the Army Roster, an additional Infantry Tercio Auxiliary Detachment without using a Command Slot.
Doctrine de Cohorte axée sur le soutien: Cohort Doctrine focused on armoured support. Models with the Vehicle Type (excluding the Flyer Sub-type) and the Solar Auxilia Trait in an Army that adheres to this Doctrine may Move while still benefiting from the Heavy (X) Special Rule; if they move no more than 4" in the Movement Phase and do not Rush, they count as Stationary that Turn for any Heavy (X) variant on their Weapons. Unlocks, for each Armoured Tercio Auxiliary Detachment on the Army Roster, an additional Armoured Tercio Auxiliary Detachment without using a Command Slot.
Doctrine de Cohorte axée sur les escadro: Cohort Doctrine focused on Sentinel squadrons. Models with the Cavalry Type and the Solar Auxilia Trait in an Army that adheres to this Doctrine may Control or Contest Objectives, move further during an Evade Reaction, and have their Initiative Characteristic set to 5 for that Reaction. Unlocks, for each Scout Tercio Auxiliary Detachment on the Army Roster, an additional Scout Tercio Auxiliary Detachment without using a Command Slot.

Doctrine de Cohorte qui intègre des auto: Cohort Doctrine that integrates Mechanicum automata into Lasrifle Sections. Doctrine de Cohorte réservée aux Armées: Cohort Doctrine restricted to Armies with the Loyalist Allegiance, focused on psycho-conditioning. Models with the Solar Auxilia Trait in an Army that adheres to this Doctrine follow two Special Rules. Psycho-conditioned: these Models ignore negative Leadership modifiers and can never suffer them on their Leadership Characteristic, but when a Unit composed entirely of such Models is chosen to score an Objective or declared as the Reacting Unit of a Reaction, it must first pass a Willpower Check before any Victory Points are scored or the Reaction Allotment is spent; if it fails, the Unit immediately gains the Stunned Status and does not score the Objective or continue the Reaction (other eligible Units belonging to the Player may still score that Objective). Imperial Mandate: these Models gain the Talons of the Emperor Trait, may be included in an Allied Detachment of a Legio Custodes Army, and the Army may never have a Legiones Auxilia Designation. Unlocks, for each Veletaris Tercio Auxiliary Detachment on the Army Roster, a Helot Tercio Auxiliary Detachment without using a Command Slot, linked to the Detachment that includes the Veletaris Command Section that unlocked that Veletaris Tercio — its Units are drawn from the Imperialis Militia Army List (not transcribed on this site).

Cohort Doctrine restricted to Armies with the Traitor Allegiance, devoted to the worship of Slaanesh. Models with the Solar Auxilia Trait in an Army that adheres to this Doctrine follow the Disciples of Pain Special Rule: they gain the Slaanesh Trait and the Fleet (1) Special Rule; such a Model with the Command Sub-type also gains the Psyker Trait and the Rapture (Enraptura) Psychic Discipline, and may not be given any other Psychic Discipline. Unlocks, for each Infantry Tercio Auxiliary Detachment on the Army Roster, an Antemasque Detachment without using a Command Slot, linked to the same Detachment as that Infantry Tercio — its Slots may only be filled by Units from the Daemons of Slaanesh Army List.

All its Slots may only hold Units from the Daemons of Slaanesh Army List; its Command Unit does not unlock any additional Detachment.

Évolution des escouades de Destroyers et: An evolution of the Destroyer and Assault squads, the jump pack-equipped Reaver Attack squads embodied in many ways the Sons of Horus' way of waging war. Heavily influenced by the tactics of the ceaseless, seething gang warfare of Cthonia, Reaver Attack units specialised in lightning-fast assaults that maimed and paralysed an enemy, eliminating leaders and sowing panic and disorder among any who survived. Of these units, the Catulan Reavers were the most infamous during the early battles of the Horus Heresy, active on both Isstvan III and V, but there were many others.
Évolution des escouades de Nettoyeurs, l: An evolution of the Purge squads, the Reavers were in many ways the archetype of the Sons of Horus' methods of war. Influenced by the tribes of Cthonia, Reaver units specialised in rapid assaults intended to paralyse the enemy by cutting down its commanders and plunging the survivors into confusion. Each Reaver unit was in effect a war band, whose members fought as individuals rather than as soldiers. The most infamous is doubtless that of the Catulan Reavers, who distinguished themselves on Isstvan III and V, where they slaughtered many Loyalists.

Armed with these new tools of war, they turned against the armies of Terra within the Warmaster's host.

La Firewing existe pour mener une guerre: The Firewing exists to wage swift and silent war, to stifle the enemy's capacity for resistance, to rob them of their will to fight through precision strikes, and to obtain key intelligence for the use of other forces. The Enigmatii are the most accomplished practitioners of this style of warfare, operating in small elite units to eliminate enemy leaders, disrupt their lines of advance and throw their plans into disarray. Armed and equipped with the finest weapons and wargear available, they pose a deadly threat to anyone the Lion deems dangerous enough to merit their attention.

La gloire d’un choc frontal peut suffire: The glory of a head-on clash may be enough to carry an enemy line, but it can also consume those who bear it until it leaves nothing behind but aimless rage.
La guerre est le creuset dans lequel la: War is the crucible in which the Gorgon was forged, for nothing else could engender the strength and resilience that Ferrus Manus demanded of his warriors. While a Model with this Special Rule is Engaged in a Challenge, its Controlling Player may choose this Gambit: Tempered by War — when this Gambit is chosen, this Model's Toughness Characteristic is set to 8 for the duration of the following Strike Step.

La moins courante des diverses Unités de: The least common of the various veteran Units usually fielded within the Legiones Astartes, Support Veterans are long-range infantry tasked with holding ground and destroying the enemy's key assets. With access to the rarest and most destructive weapons held in their Legion's armoury, these warriors can be equipped to face a wide variety of threats, making the most of their seasoned skills to secure victory.
La moitié de table du Défenseur doit com: The Defender's table half should have more terrain representing defensive barriers, trench lines and bunkers. The Attacker's table half should be relatively flat, with more open ground lightly cluttered with tank wrecks or drop pods.
Là où l'essentiel de la force de bataill: Where the bulk of the battle force is mounted on Spatha bikes or Scimitar Jetbikes, Chaplains too are able to requisition such mounts to fight alongside their brothers. Astride them, they brandish their Crozius Arcanum high as they charge into the heart of the enemy ranks, like avatars of their Primarch's wrath.
Là où les khans des White Scars déploien: Where the khans of the White Scars deploy assault troops onto the battlefield, they are accompanied by similarly equipped Stormseers, able to keep pace with the rapid modes of attack commonly employed and to join the heart of the battle.
Là où les unités d'assaut de bien d'autr: Where the assault units of many other Legions are known for their savagery, the Locutarus are distinguished by universal discipline and rigour. Their training elevates bladework to an art, but instead of focusing on the individual skill of each warrior, the Locutarus train as a unit in synchronicity, so that every blow is perfectly calculated and coordinated. In pitched battles, Locutarus Assault squads are often held in reserve, their officers waiting for the perfect moment to commit them, and with a single Charge tipping the outcome of the fight in the Ultramarines' favour. The Blade of Wisdom — The Blade of Wisdom is an advanced assault strategy first devised during the Great Crusade. The Locutarus launch a perfectly synchronised Charge against enemies pinned down by the deadly accurate fire of mutually supporting Ultramarines units, and swiftly annihilate their foes in a deluge of expert sword strokes. Argean power sword — forged by the master artisans of Heliopolis on Macragge, the Argean power sword borne by each Locutarus is an artificer weapon that serves as much as a mark of courage and honour as a deadly tool of war.

La plupart des commandants légionnaires: Most Legion commanders showed a marked preference for the new generation of artillery tanks, faster and easier to maintain, able to keep pace with the mobile and dynamic battle doctrines employed during the Great Crusade. Despite this, many Legions retained reserve formations of older mobile artillery patterns, such as Basilisks, which were recalled from the rear echelons to take part in protracted sieges. Their relative lack of mobility was considered secondary to their immense guns, capable of methodically pounding fixed enemy positions from afar in such situations.

For many commanders, advancing such standards and icons as quickly as possible is a priority, so as to leave the enemy no respite nor any safe haven from the onslaught. In such cases, the speed and mobility of bikes and jetbikes are exploited to the full.

La signification rituelle de la flamme p: The ritual significance of the purifying flame was central to the many sub-sects of the Promethean Cult that emerged in the wake of the Dropsite Massacre, employed to dreadful effect on the battlefields of the Horus Heresy. La variante d'Armigère dite Moirax, peu: The Armiger variant known as the Moirax, little used before the darkest hours of the Horus Heresy, was most frequently sent into battle by Households indentured to the Mechanicum. The Rad Furnace at the heart of the machine, and the reactor leaks and critical ambaric malfunctions that resulted, very often led to the contamination of the machine spirit and of the pilot, often considered inferior and expendable by their lord. Though assured of every other favour, these pilots were excluded from a place at the Questoris Court and from the right to perpetuate their lineage.
La variante Prometheus du Spartan, dotée: The Prometheus variant of the Spartan, equipped with an excellent battery of defensive weapons, has long served as the basis for the Space Marines' specialised command vehicles. Legion Techmarines convert the immense transport bay into a command pod housing powerful vox transceivers and advanced holographic topographic auguries, allowing the commander sealed within to perceive the battlefield from above and in detail. Though a Praetor so ensconced cannot take part in person in the unfolding battle, their ability to observe and direct the Legion's warriors as they fight has often proven more vital to securing victory over the foe. This Model has an Access Point on each Side and on the Front.

Their primary detachment must be drawn from the Mechanicum army list and should include an allied detachment drawn from the Legiones Astartes army list and the Alpha Legion Faction.

The Defender represents the Traitor force, with a Points Limit of 3000 points. Their primary detachment is drawn from the Legiones Astartes army list and the Thousand Sons Faction, and their army must include an allied detachment of at least 500 points drawn from the Daemons of Tzeentch army list.
Le <strong>Terrain Toxique</strong> repr: Toxic Terrain represents the aftermath of the most abhorrent strikes of the Horus Heresy — phage or nucleonic weapons so destructive that they corrupt the very substance of the planet. In any mission, if both players agree, any area of Difficult Terrain may be designated as Toxic Terrain; some missions require it in their rules.
Le Ætos Dios ne peut être inclus que dan: The Ætos Dios can only be included in an Army that also includes Rogal Dorn. If the Ætos Dios is included in an Army in this way, Rogal Dorn must begin the battle Embarked on it.
Le blason noirci, l'honneur perdu, les B: Their heraldry blackened, their honour lost, the Blackshields no longer fight for a Primarch or an Emperor, but for their own bitter reasons.
Le bouclier éclipse confère un Jet de Mi: The Eclipse shield grants a 5+ Shrouded Damage Mitigation Roll against Shooting Attacks when a Model suffers a Penetrating Hit. The first time in a Battle Turn that a Model equipped with an Eclipse shield suffers a Penetrating Hit, it gains a 5+ Shrouded Damage Mitigation Roll against all subsequent Shooting Attacks, until it returns to Aerial Reserves.
Le Caché, Capitaine de la Neuvième Commu: The Hidden One, Captain of the Ninth Fellowship, Tutor of Magnus, Keeper of the Keys. It is whispered that Amon was once Magnus's tutor, before the Emperor came to Prospero, but if this rumour is true, it would mean he was converted into a Space Marine as an adult and survived, perhaps aided in this by Magnus's direct intervention, and became both a talented warrior and a powerful psyker. Master of the Legion's intelligence services, the "Hidden Ones", Amon survived the Battle of Prospero, where he was grievously wounded, and, consumed by bitterness, he isolated himself more and more from his masters and peers.
Le camp loyaliste doit répartir ses forc: The Loyalist side must spread its forces around several sensitive points, accept an initially defensive posture, then exploit the arrival of its reinforcements to regain the local advantage. The Traitor attacker seeks to strike fast, pick their targets and disrupt enemy reactions before the VII<sup>th</sup> Legion Terminators stabilise the front.
Le Capitaine-rempart déshonoré Medraut m: The disgraced Bastion Captain Medraut leads a heavy Legio Custodes assault force deep into a daemon-infested underground hive city on the planet Kol, unaware of the horrors that await him there.

Le châssis moins avancé du Dreadnought m: The less advanced chassis of the Castra Ferrum pattern Dreadnought is not as compatible with the wide array of armaments that can be freely mounted and supported by the more powerful Contemptor chassis, but the material cost of the Horus Heresy drove many of these Dreadnought patterns into the heart of the fighting. Adaptations such as the "Mortis pattern" configuration mount paired heavy weapons, such as batteries of autocannons or heavy bolters, allowing Castra Ferrum Dreadnoughts to unleash withering fire against both ground and airborne targets.
Le Chevalier Armigère est un homologue p: The Armiger Knight is a more agile and lighter counterpart to the Questoris Knight, and often fought alongside such allies during the Great Crusade, eliminating threats from enemies that the larger Knights did not identify, such as swarms of infantry attempting to pass the protective barrier of their ion shields in order to plant explosives directly on their frame. Armiger Warglaives are armed with menacing thermal spears and fearsome reaper chain-cleavers, well suited to the bellicose and aggressive nature of their pilots.
Le Chevalier Astérius compte parmi les e: The Knight Asterius is among the most formidable and massive engines of destruction available to the Houses, equipped with heavy conversion armament that can reduce the greatest edifices to dust, and even threaten Titans. The Knight Asterius's secondary weapon systems are just as fearsome: a Karacnos mortar mounted on its carapace, capable of annihilating whole phalanxes of troops in formation, as are the volkite culverins in its torso. Only the strongest-minded dare try to control the raging fire that stirs the machine spirit of a Knight Asterius and soon spreads to them.
Le Chevalier Cerastus Achéron est une vi: The Cerastus Knight Acheron is a disturbing sight, a reaper of lives carefully designed not only to destroy but to inspire terror. Its presence warns the enemy that no quarter will be given, for such weapons are deployed only on missions of extermination, to overthrow the foe's works and put their lands to the flame. The rare pilots with a taste for these grim mounts are warriors of iron will, able to suppress the sinister whispers of their machine spirit, or tortured souls who relish this suit's malevolent urges and the carnage it sows on the battlefield.
Le Chevalier Magaera est une merveille t: The Knight Magaera is a technological marvel rarely seen outside the vassal Houses of the Mechanicum, which jealously guards the secrets of its creation. Armed with a lightning cannon that pulverises heavy infantry and vehicles alike, and a siege claw able to rip open the thickest fortifications, the Knight Magaera is often placed at the forefront of the assaults Households launch. However, owing to the excessive levels of radiation seeping from the reactor core, and the risk of catastrophic internal explosions when heavily damaged, piloting one is cause for celebration as much as concern.
Le Chevalier Questoris était le harnois: The Questoris Knight was the most common suit in the Imperium at the time the Horus Heresy broke out. Its popularity among the noble scions of the Questoris Households was such that the pattern was reconfigured with various weapon options and hull upgrades in a myriad of ways, given names such as Paladin, Errant, Vigilant, Gallant and Crusader according to traditions, lineages and their styles of combat. Little different from the ancient engines carried to the stars by the first colonists of the Long March, Questoris Knights are the very embodiment of the heritage of the Knight Households.

Le Joueur en Contrôle de Sigismund doit: Sigismund's Controlling Player must issue a Challenge if possible, and chooses which opponent accepts it. In the Controlling Player's Challenge Sub-Phase, if Sigismund is eligible, he must be declared the Challenger. If a Combat contains more than one Model under the Active Player's control that must be the Challenger, that player must choose Sigismund as the Challenger. In addition, when the Controlling Player issues a Challenge for Sigismund (including during the Heroic Intervention Advanced Reaction), they may choose the Challenged model from among any of the Opponent's eligible Models. If, for any reason, the chosen enemy Model cannot be the Challenged model, Sigismund's Controlling Player gains a number of Combat Resolution Points equal to the Base Wounds Characteristic of the chosen enemy Model that did not become the Challenged model, and Sigismund's Controlling Player may then choose another eligible Model to accept the Challenge.

They are deployed using the normal rules for entering play from Reserves, but must all arrive from the same edge of the battlefield.

Le joueur qui a choisi sa zone de déploi: The player who chose their deployment zone in step 3 deploys all units in their army that are not in Reserves in that zone. The other player then deploys their army in the same way in the remaining zone.
Le joueur qui a déployé en premier à l’é: The player who deployed first in step 6 takes the first Player Turn. All Leviathan missions last at least four Battle Turns. At the end of the fourth, the player with the fewest Victory Points may roll a D6: on a 1-3, the battle ends; on a 4+, one additional Battle Turn is played, then the battle ends.

The other models in the unit are then placed in unit coherency with at least one other model in the unit, and within 6″ of the first model placed.

The Ultramarines defender seeks to hold the zone of honour, wear down the Indurate and let time work in their favour until the enemy assault starts to unravel.
Le Khan Proscrit, Sagyar Mazan, Chercheu: The Outcast Khan, Sagyar Mazan, Seeker of Atonement.
Le Khenetai Occulte était chargé de prot: The Khenetai Occult was charged with protecting the Cults of Prospero, along with their reliquaries and sanctuaries. The most talented warriors of the Khenetai formed cabals of "blades", gifted swordsmen who had placed their psychic powers in the service of their mastery of swordplay. The paired force swords they wielded were forged from sheets of ceramite inlaid with gold and engraved with symbols denoting their secret names and their bearer's victories. The Khenetai fought with such coordination that they seemed more like several bodies moved by a single will than a group of individuals. The Models in this Unit have their own Prosperine Arcana (Khenetai), which gives them access to the Bladeweave Psychic Reaction, the Mind-song of Blades Psychic Power and the "Khenetai" Trait.
Le Lancier est le plus célèbre des harno: The Lancer is the most famous of the Cerastus-type Knight suits, a highly sophisticated chassis that far outstrips the more ponderous Questoris class in speed. Cerastus Knights seem to have been designed for war alone, not as protectors but as conquerors and tools of destruction, a mark of the violence that permeated the dawn of the Age of Strife. The Lancer is held in high esteem by the most impetuous champions of the Houses, its mighty ion gauntlet shield and shock lance being perfectly suited to facing the foe head-on, where a single well-placed blow separates the pilot from death.
Le Linceul est un groupe de guerriers d': The Deathshroud are a group of elite warriors, clad in heavy Terminator Armour and armed with fearsome alchem projectors and great power scythes. Selected by Mortarion himself for their skill, courage and endurance, they were often chosen because they were the last survivors of their unit. The Deathshroud Terminators were Mortarion's silent bodyguards, and prevented anyone from troubling their Primarch by crossing their blades and fixing the intruder with their gaze.
Le livre de règles décrit les Legios Tit: The rulebook describes the Titan Legions as they were before the schism of the Horus Heresy, the corruption of the Dark Mechanicum and Horus's civil war. This does not mean that only loyalist armies can be represented: within every forge world, factions of all sizes defied their High Princeps and the forge worlds to which they were vassals, to side with whichever camp seemed to them the rightful destiny of the Imperium. This is why players are free to use this book to create armies of either allegiance.

Le Maréchal Légat commande une Cohorte e: The Legate Marshal commands an entire Solar Auxilia Cohort: their presence in a Primary Detachment grants the Army a bonus Reaction Allotment.
Le Marteau Aurique, l'Exemplaire, Seigne: The Auric Hammer, the Exemplar, Lord Commander Primus of the Emperor's Children.
Le massacre du site d’atterrissage fut l: The Dropsite Massacre was one of the very first engagements in which the Warmaster's forces deployed only Imperial troops. The records contain no account of traitor warriors wearing Saturnine pattern armour in the Urgall Depression: to represent Isstvan V faithfully, only the Attacker should select these units.
Le Medusa de Légion partage de nombreux: The Legion Medusa shares many components with the Basilisk, but in place of the long-range Earthshaker cannon it is fitted with a large-calibre siege mortar. In doing so, the Medusa sacrifices range in favour of sheer destructive power, a compromise further accentuated by the fact that it is mounted on a relatively lightly armoured and slow platform. Despite this, these venerable tanks were called upon to provide close fire support on the front lines of the countless battles of the Horus Heresy, their crews knowing all too well the vulnerabilities of the vehicles they crewed.
Le modèle d'Armure Tactique Dreadnought: The Gorgon pattern of Tactical Dreadnought Armour was one of the many attempts by Ferrus Manus and his Iron Fathers to improve upon the various patterns of Terminator armour used by the Legiones Astartes.
Le Molosse Déchiré, Praetor du Blackshie: The Riven Hound, Praetor of the Blackshield, the Fangs of the Emperor. Once of the World Eaters Legion, Endryd Haar and his command were long thought lost on Crusade when their brothers-in-arms joined the Traitors' cause. Endryd sank into a cold madness on discovering his Legion's betrayal upon his return, finding the Imperium torn apart by civil war; he erased every trace of his Legion's insignia and honours, and swore a death oath to atone for the crimes of the XII Legion. Endryd Haar fought alongside the Loyalists as a field commander in the dark days that preceded the Siege of Terra, accepting any mission, whatever the chances of survival, so long as it allowed him to spill the enemy's blood.
Le Mouvement de Repli peut se faire dans: The Fall Back Move may be made in any direction (even into contact with the enemy, which removes the Routed Status); but when out of Combat at the end of the Turn (from Turn 2 onwards), a failed Cool test imposes the Routed Status.
