Le Phénicien Déifié, Avatar de la Perfec: The Deified Phoenician, Avatar of Perfection. Fulgrim aspired to perfection in all things, which left him open to doubt and hubris, the seeds of which were cultivated by the malevolent spirit that inhabited the Blade of the Laer. After his daemonic apotheosis in the ancient xenos citadel beneath the fallen world of Lydris, Fulgrim shed his original body for a monstrous form granted by his new patron deity. Endowed with a serpentine lower half, great wings and a second pair of arms, Fulgrim's new body raised an exceptional warrior to even greater heights, close to the perfection he so desired.
Le plus sanguinaire et le plus sauvage d: The most bloodthirsty and savage of the Primarchs, master of the World Eaters Legion, Lord of the Red Sands.
Le plus souvent désignées pour servir da: Most often assigned to serve in the immediate retinue of a similarly equipped Legion Praetor, Praetorian Command Squads may be given specialised Outrider roles. These veterans master the doctrines of mounted warfare and exploit powerful Spatha pattern jetbikes to scout the way ahead of the main force and engage the enemy, or to outflank their position and exploit their weaknesses with lightning attacks.

Le Praevius part au combat escorté d'aut: The Praevius goes to war escorted by imposing automata that make formidable bodyguards. On the battlefield the Praevius can exert more direct control over their actions, and direct their fearsome firepower with a single gesture. This Special Rule allows a Praevius to be accompanied by a Battle-automata Unit. When a Model with this Special Rule is included in a Detachment, an additional Force Organisation Slot is added to that Detachment. This Slot can only be filled by a Castellax Battle Maniple or Castellax Destructor Maniple Unit selected from the Liber Mechanicum. When such a Unit is included in this way, its Cybernetica Trait is replaced by "Bonded Automata", and the Unit can be included even though it does not have the same Faction Trait as the other Units in the Detachment. In addition, a Model with this Special Rule can join a friendly Unit that includes Models with the Automata Type. If a Model with this Special Rule joins a Unit with the Automata Type, the Leadership and Cool Characteristics of the Models in that Unit are not reduced because of this, but other Rules can modify them as normal.

Le recours aux augmentations cybernétiqu: The Iron Hands' use of cybernetic augmentation guaranteed a high flow of new recruits even when biological resources ran short or the implantation of other organs had failed. After the death of Ferrus Manus and the losses suffered at Isstvan V, these warriors also came to regard the forbidden technologies employed by their Legion as commonplace, their desire to punish the Traitors outweighing any reservations about their provenance.
Le Rédempteur Écarlate, Commandant du So: The Crimson Lord, Commander of the Serrated Sun. Argel Tal was one of the first to gaze upon the madness of the Eye of Terror, and he earned eternal damnation when the tortured abyss gazed back. Held up as the perfect example of what his Primarch meant by the fusion of the human soul and the power of the Daemon, he and his brothers of the Gal Vorbak played a decisive role in the galactic tragedy that befell humanity.

Le sobriquet officieux de « Tueurs de So: The unofficial sobriquet of "Sun Killers" was given to a number of elite heavy support squads of the III Legion. Armed exclusively with energy weapons, they sought out the largest enemy constructs or life forms so as to be alone in bringing about their destruction. On the rare occasions when Fulgrim's warriors had to make a strategic withdrawal, it fell to the Sun Killers to provide covering fire, not out of oath or duty but out of sheer martial pride. Records of Sun Killers having failed in their mission are all but unknown, and it has long been suspected that they were erased from the Legion's data banks on the orders of Fulgrim himself.

Le Terrain Toxique suit toutes les règle: Toxic Terrain follows all the rules for Difficult Terrain (page 236 of the Age of Darkness Rulebook). In addition, any model that enters, leaves or moves through an area of Toxic Terrain is affected by the Necrotic Annihilation special rule.
Le tireur déclare quelles armes de son u: The shooter declares which weapons in their unit take part in the shooting (one weapon per model, unless a special rule says otherwise), respecting range and Line of Sight for each. Le titan s’arrête, hors de combat mais p: The Titan shuts down, out of action but not destroyed: it can no longer move or attack. The opposing player scores the Engine Kill Victory Points.

Le Tourmenteur est un prodige de convers: The Tormentor is a prodigious conversion of a Shadowsword super-heavy tank, maintained by the Iron Warriors Legion even after this type of vehicle was abandoned within the Legions. Used as a mobile command vehicle, as resilient as it is deadly, the vehicle's superstructure and engine were radically reworked to accommodate Perturabo at his proper scale, along with his Iron Circle bodyguards. No more efficient killing machine existed in the Iron Warriors' vehicle pool. This Model has Access Points on its Rear facing.

Designer's Note: this does not override the rule that all Units in the same Detachment must share the same Faction Trait — a Unit that includes Models with the Knights-Errant Faction Trait can therefore only be included in a Detachment whose other Units have that same Trait.

Les <strong>Atouts de champ de bataille<: Battlefield Assets (Battlefield Assets) are a mission special rule representing automated, or at least unmanned, equipment or defences. Each player selects some for their army: some benefit their owner, others make the terrain more dangerous. Each is represented by a small marker showing its position. They can be used with the existing mission packs, and even in legendary missions when these say so.
Les <strong>deux joueurs</strong> doiven: Both players must include at least one Lord of War unit in their army.
Les 18 Primarques et une poignée de puis: The 18 Primarchs and a handful of mighty warriors. No army may spend more than 25% of its Points Limit on the Warlord and Lord of War Battlefield Roles (combined allowance).
Les académies d’entraînement d’Armatura: The training academies of Armatura have been ravaged by the World Eaters and the Word Bearers. The newly formed Saturnine Terminator squad Alepho receives a distress signal from the Decalian district and advances through a landscape of rubble, ambushes and harassing strikes launched from the air by the Night Lords. After a full day and a night of marching under enemy fire, the warriors finally reach the beacon, only to find a field of destruction and the mutilated remains of the defenders.
Les Aéronefs qui entrent en jeu depuis l: Flyers entering play from Aerial Reserves may only be given the Strike (Strike) mission Combat Assignment.
Les archives de la Grande Croisade docum: The archives of the Great Crusade document many successful deployments of Legion Siege Breakers who employed Terminator armour patterns to aid in carrying out their orders. Such warriors met with notable success on missions in areas designated "Zones Mortalis", where the oppressive narrowness of underground tunnels or the claustrophobic interiors of collapsing hives posed as great a threat as the enemy itself. This Model may be replaced by 1 Siege Breaker Tartaros for free. This Unit counts as a Siege Breaker Unit for the selection of the Storm Battery Auxiliary Detachment and for the options of the Rapier Battery and Arquitor Bombard Unit Profiles.
Les Armes ayant cette Règle Spéciale ont: Weapons with this Special Rule have a chance to inflict Statuses on Vehicles even without penetrating their armour. When making a Hit Test for a Weapon with this Special Rule against a Target Unit that includes any Model with the Vehicle or Walker Type, note the result of the Hit Test before any modifiers. If the result is a "5" or "6" before any modifiers, all Models with the Vehicle or Walker Type in the Target Unit gain a Status (based on the value of X) at the end of Step 11 of the Shooting Attack process or Step 10 of the Initiative Step process; if the Model already has that Status, or the attack would apply it more than once, there is no further effect. This Special Rule never causes the loss of Wounds or Hull Points, and the Hits inflicted do not cause a Wound Test or an Armour Penetration Test.

Les armes psychiques sont des armes tout: Psychic weapons are entirely normal weapons — same characteristics, same shooting or melee rules — except that they have the Psychic trait and only a Psyker can use them. Many are not even represented on the model.
Les Assassins du Clade Vindicare aliment: The Assassins of the Vindicare Clade feed the myths and legends of the Imperium, for it is said that once in the sights of one of these elusive killers, the prey cannot escape a shot of unheard-of precision. Trained for decades to raise killing to an art, they combine physical positioning, topological mapping and in-depth study of their target to bring it down swiftly from afar, before slipping away and leaving only death as proof of their passing. Many snipers haunt the battlefields of the galaxy, but none can call themselves the equal of the Vindicare Clade.
Les assauts des Iron Hands étaient typiq: Iron Hands assaults were typically led by phalanxes of implacable Terminators accompanied by Dreadnoughts and supported by cybernetically augmented warriors. This Detachment's Command Slot may only be used to select a Praevius Unit. May only be selected if the Army also includes an Iron Father or Ferrus Manus Unit.
Les Atouts aux Traits <strong>Attaquant<: Assets with the Attacker or Defender Traits can only be selected by the player taking that role in the mission. Likewise, Assets with the Loyalist or Traitor Traits can only be selected by a player whose army has that Allegiance.
Les Atramentar n'avaient pas juré fidéli: The Atramentar had sworn fealty neither to their Legion nor to their Primarch, but to Sevatar alone. In battle, they followed his orders without question, without remorse or hesitation. It was a rare example of loyalty within a Legion renowned for its treachery and lack of honour. When included in an Army in which a Sevatar Model has been selected in the Primary Detachment and is on the battlefield, the Controlling Player of a Atramentar Flay-clade Unit may always use Sevatar's Base Leadership Characteristic instead of the Unit's for any Leadership Check made for this Unit.
Les Attaques de Tir à grande distance on: Long-range Shooting Attacks find it harder to hit Raven Guard Models.

Les Attaques de Tir qui ciblent les Iron: Shooting Attacks that target the Iron Hands suffer a Strength penalty.
Les Attaques de Tir qui touchent la Figu: Shooting Attacks that hit the equipped Model do not benefit from the Armourbane Special Rule.
Les Attaques faites avec la Règle Spécia: Attacks made with the Phase Shift (X) Special Rule sometimes ignore all Damage Mitigation Rolls and Saving Throws. When a Wound Test is made for an Attack with this Special Rule, and that Wound Test is equal to or greater than the value of X attached to this variant of the Special Rule, all Damage Mitigation Rolls and Saving Throws are ignored for the Wound inflicted. This Special Rule can only be triggered by a Wound Test and has no effect when making an Armour Penetration Test.
Les automates laissés trop longtemps san: Automata left unsupervised for too long often suffer severe logic degradation. Once the bodyguard of Perturabo himself and held in high esteem by their Primarch and their Legion, their failure at the Battle of Phall reduced them to the wretched state in which they found themselves during the Horus Heresy. The automata of the Iron Circle, which had replaced them as Perturabo's bodyguard, were a constant reminder of their failures in the first battles of the Horus Heresy and became the target of malicious disdain. Les combattants de la Stormwing sont des: The warriors of the Stormwing are artists of destruction, whose brushstrokes are the fire they unleash upon the canvas of the battlefield, and they form the heart of the Dark Angels Legion. Stormwing Musters employ heavy infantry tactics, combining the might of every warrior into an inexorable tide.
Les créatures que l'on désigne sous le n: The creatures known as "brutes" form the vanguard of the Ruinstorm hordes, created to break the ranks of mortal armies and serve as a bulwark for the lesser Daemons that follow in their wake. Though diverse in form, each towers over even the augmented warriors of the Legiones Astartes and is able to weather massed bolter fire. Bursting forth from the depths of the Warp, a phalanx of such creatures sweeps across the battlefield, revelling in carnage until finally cast back into the Immaterium.
Les Dark Angels en tant que Légion recèl: The Dark Angels as a Legion harbour a multitude of Orders and Chambers Militant dedicated to the preservation and perfection of a specific martial doctrine.

He is believed to have received the title of Magister Vodien, archive-master of religious doctrine on his mysterious world, but some time later he was overthrown, until a secret Loyalist operation, the Xana Incursion, ended in disaster, allowing him to launch a coup to eliminate the Xana Synod. He emerged more powerful than ever. Archmagos of the Xanain Domain — despite his monstrous appearance, Scoria was among the finest cybertheurgists hailing from the forge worlds of the galactic north-west: he has specific Cybertheurgic Rites, and knows the following Cybertheurgic Rites: Overcharged Reactors, Cogitator Purge, Anticode Infection.

In battle, these agile warriors take the high ground to ply their marksman's skills, or race ahead of the main advance to launch daring assaults on objectives, holding them until slower troops arrive to relieve them.

Unlike many Destroyer cadres, it was common for the Nemesis Chapter to retain a high proportion of bolters as primary armament, complementing their tactical flexibility with the addition of specialised ammunition loads based on incendiary or acidic chemical compounds designed to wreak such destruction that fear would break the spirit of the survivors.

Les forces d’assaut poussent leurs blind: The assault forces push their heavy armour forward on a broad front, confining the defenders to their own territory.
Les Gal Vorbak sont issus de ce qu'il re: The Gal Vorbak are drawn from what remains of the Serrated Sun Chapter of the Word Bearers Legion, who explored the depths of the Eye of Terror and returned forever transfigured. Their psyches infiltrated by creatures from the darkness of the Aether, the survivors were renamed Gal Vorbak, or "Blessed Sons" in the tongue of Colchis. In battle, their hands become talons and their mouths foaming, fanged maws. Even before this transformation is complete, these frothing killers leap upon the foe to tear them to pieces.

The warriors tasked with protecting the army's officers.
Les guerriers des Fulmentarus sont équip: The warriors of the Fulmentarus are equipped with Cataphractii pattern Terminator armour, reinforced to carry a whole suite of targeting systems that allow each of them to combine their fire in perfectly coordinated fashion. Combined with the Fulmentarus missile array, these sensors make the Fulmentarus a formidable heavy assault unit which, but for the outbreak of the Horus Heresy, might one day have entered service across all the Legiones Astartes. Peritarch Targeter — the peritarch targeter is a sophisticated tracking system that compiles the sweep arcs of multiple auspex units carried throughout a squad to form an overlay of detailed trajectory projections, guaranteeing inescapable target locks. When a Unit that includes Models with a Peritarch Targeter is selected to make a Shooting Attack, if that Unit remained Stationary during its Controlling Player's previous Movement Phase, no Shrouded Damage Mitigation Rolls may be made against attacks made as part of that Shooting Attack. In addition, the Controlling Player may make an Intelligence Check for that Unit: if it is passed, until that Shooting Attack has been fully resolved, the Ballistic Skill Characteristic of Models in that Unit with a Peritarch Targeter is modified by +1. Fulmentarus missile array — designed from the study and refinement of the Cyclone missile launcher first employed by Siege Tyrant Terminators, the Fulmentarus missile array uses long-range shatter missiles to subdue enemies whose armour or innate toughness renders them impervious to lesser weapons, or advanced Hellfire plasma missiles that detonate inside their target.
Les hordes de la Tempête de la Ruine son: The hordes of the Ruinstorm are made up of multitudes of lesser Daemons, each a pale reflection of the patron it serves. On the battlefield, they gather in packs with their own kind, recognisable by common traits such as blood-red skin, sinuous appendages, festering maws or countless other terrifying visages that defy mortal logic. Despite their unnatural and frightening appearance, these Daemons seem to imitate the behaviour of warriors, albeit of a barbaric and primitive kind, presumably to satisfy the demands of their dark patrons.
Les Horreurs sont des formes humanoïdes: Horrors are twisted humanoid forms that cavort across the battlefield, assailing their targets with conjured orbs of warp energy. Struck in anger, their fleshy forms split easily, but they do not always perish: a new animus is breathed into the severed pieces, each forming a new Horror. Though smaller, these new Daemons fight with undiminished vigour, clambering over one another to overwhelm their assailants. Blue Horrors only enter play through the Infernal Mitosis Reaction.
Les Hykanatoi sont le cœur battant de la: The Hykanatoi are the beating heart of the Legio Custodes: they are at once the most numerous of its warrior caste subdivisions and the emblematic archetype by which outsiders identify the Emperor's famed Custodians. The Proconsul-Delegates found in their ranks have mastered the art of battle in both the Sentinel Guard and the Custodian Guard; they are known for their keen sense of the flow of combat, whether striding across teeming battlefields or the towering ramparts of the Imperial Palace, and they often command smaller bands of Custodians on any mission that does not require the attention of the Bastion Captains.
Les Imperial Fists gagnent un bonus de +: Imperial Fists gain a +1 bonus when making Hit Tests with multiple Bolt and Auto Weapons.
Les Inductii des Death Guard passaient u: The Death Guard Inductii spent much of their training separated from the bulk of the Legion. Sent out from small garrisons or from Barbarus itself to fortify, endure and, where possible, increase their numbers, these warriors spread across the galaxy like a pestilence. Many enemies were annihilated upon stumbling onto these hidden garrisons, unaware of the threat until it consumed them.
Les Inductii des Space Wolves furent con: The Inductii of the Space Wolves were conditioned to idealise the warrior traditions of Fenris, each seeking to prove their skill with blade and shield. With little time devoted to training or indoctrination, these warriors were physically augmented and then thrown into the crucible of battle, there to be forged into true Legionaries.
Les Inductii des World Eaters vivaient d: The Inductii of the World Eaters lived short and typically brutal lives, thrown into battle with little regard for preserving numbers or reducing losses. Implanted with the Butcher's Nails from an early age, their tortured minds inhabited vat-grown bodies, producing killers even more unstable, but undoubtedly ferocious, devoid of any notion of pain, fear or defeat.
Les Indurés chargent la garde d’honneur: The Indurate charge the Ultramarines honour guard while two Primarchs clash in the background.
Les Iron Hands étaient des parangons du: The Iron Hands were paragons of armoured warfare, combining tank detachments with mechanised troops in heavy transports. This Detachment's Heavy Transport Slots may only be used to select Land Raider Carrier or Spartan Units.

Les Karaoghlanlar étaient souvent accomp: The Karaoghlanlar were often accompanied into battle by a Stormseer, who ritually marked their armour before battle so that their spirits would not be sullied by the deeds they had to perform. This attunement also allowed Stormseers to reach them through thought, coming to their aid more easily even amid the tumult of battle. A Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule may be selected as the Target of the Call of the Wind Psychic Power of the Call of the Storm Discipline as long as it has at least one Model within 24" of the Focus instead of 12", and even if none of its Models has Line of Sight to the Focus.
Les Karaoghlanlar, surnommés Fils Sombre: The Karaoghlanlar, nicknamed the Dark Sons of Death by those not of Chogorian descent, were the ultimate, irrevocable measure of the White Scars, employed when the enemy had fallen too far for any hope of Imperial Compliance to remain, or against an abhorrent xenos strain that could not be tolerated. The Karaoghlanlar sought not only to bring about the physical end of their enemies but also, through ancient Chogorian rites, their spiritual annihilation.
Les Larmes de l'Ange, Masques d'Argent e: The Angel's Tears, Silver Masks and Hands of Justice, play the role among the Blood Angels that Destroyers play in other Legions: they go into battle under the direct command of Sanguinius.
Les Légions Brisées ne sont pas une List: The Shattered Legions are not a separate Army List: they are a supplement that reuses the Legiones Astartes Army List in full (all Units already on this site remain usable as they are), with a replacement Faction Trait and a few rules of their own. Everything always starts from a Crusade Primary Detachment, to which other detachments are then added.
Les Lernéens sont, à l'instar du monstre: The Lernaeans are, like the monster that inspired their name and their Legion's iconography, a legend without precise form, the object of a dull terror. They are the venomous jaws of the Hydra, the ferocious assault coming from all sides at once. And just like the mythological monster, they are practically impossible to eliminate. The Lernaeans are equipped with baroquely ornamented Cataphractii Tactical Dreadnought Armour and armed with volkite chargers, making them formidable assault units. Having secured the objective, they defend it as fiercely as the monster whose symbol they have borrowed.
Les Maîtres de la Descente plongent sur: Masters of the Descent plunge onto the battlefield ahead of the rest of their forces, often the first to set foot on the field of battle. A Model with this Special Rule may arrive by Deep Strike from the first Battle Turn. If a Model with this Special Rule is in Reserves, and that Model and all other Models in the same Unit have the Infantry Type and the Antigrav Sub-type, that Model's Unit may use the Deep Strike Special Rule to enter play from the first Battle Turn. Only one Unit in an Army may make use of this Special Rule in any single Battle Turn.
Les marqueurs d’objectif sont placés com: The objective markers are placed as shown on the deployment map.

Les meilleurs guerriers et les vétérans: The finest warriors and most ancient veterans among the Deathwing form the ranks of the Companions, each such detachment having sworn the strictest oaths to ensure the survival of the officers placed in their care. The most celebrated among the Companions are those who have taken a fatal blow meant for their charge and survived it. Such warriors are granted the right to wear bone-white armour in recognition of their unreserved devotion to the Legion. On occasion, they take the field clad in sturdy Cataphractii Terminator armour, whose more resilient plate better shields those they have sworn to protect.

Les meilleurs guerriers et vétérans de l: The finest warriors and veterans of the Deathwing form the ranks of the Companions, each detachment of which swears to guarantee the protection of the officers entrusted to them.
Les missions Armoured Spearhead opposent: Armoured Spearhead missions pit large armies of armoured vehicles against each other, with little room for infantry. They are an alternative way to play, designed as fun interludes rather than introductory games or rigorously balanced competitive missions. Whether played as a one-off game or in a campaign, follow the sequence below, completing each step fully before moving on to the next.
Les missions d’Onslaught représentent de: Onslaught missions represent large-scale attacks against positions already held by the defending force. They are deliberately asymmetric: the Attacker and the Defender do not score their victory points in the same way. They can be played on their own, as part of a campaign, or alternating roles to compare cumulative scores.
Les missions d’Onslaught utilisent des o: Onslaught missions use primary and secondary mission objectives. The primary objective generally requires controlling objective markers to score victory points. They represent critical points or resources to be held, and follow the core mission rules, with a few exceptions specific to the format.
Les missions du livre de règles se dérou: The missions in the rulebook are played over 4 rounds, in which each player takes a turn, one after the other.
Les missions légendaires remplacent la m: Legendary missions replace the core mission and are played as they are. Narrative missions, on the other hand, describe a situation, victory conditions and a few house rules: feel free to adapt the forces, terrain and points thresholds to your game format.
Les missions Leviathan découpent le cham: Leviathan missions divide the battlefield into sectors; their victory conditions require interacting with these sectors in different ways.
Les missions Leviathan peuvent aussi com: Leviathan missions may also include objective markers on their deployment map. They follow all the rules on pages 308-309 of the Age of Darkness Rulebook; each mission specifies how and when they score Victory Points.
Les modificateurs négatifs au Commandeme: Negative modifiers to Leadership, Willpower, Cool and Intelligence are limited for the Dark Angels.
Les Motos d'Assaut sont des motojets plu: Attack Bikes are larger jetbikes, often two-seaters, whose widened chassis can accommodate a heavy weapon, forming a formidable if relatively fragile firing platform. Attack Bikes often accompany Outrider Units to provide them with fire support, and are also deployed in squadrons as a fast strike force to ravage slower, larger enemy Units and destroy isolated armoured vehicles.
Les murmures malveillants de Samus ont,: The malevolent whispers of Samus are said to have driven whole civilisations mad with paranoia and terror. Able to possess any being save the most vigilant souls, Samus takes immense pleasure in turning its host against its companions, slaughtering those who moments before were still brothers-in-arms. Throughout the Age of Darkness, Samus has left a trail of devastation across the wounded Imperium, encountered sometimes in a form bound to the will of the traitor hordes, sometimes manifesting of its own accord, the coming of the Ruinstorm allowing it once again to prey upon the worlds of Humanity.
Les Night Lords ont une Caractéristique: Night Lords have an improved Weapon Skill Characteristic when fighting Units subject to Tactical Statuses.
Les Numérologistes des Thousand Sons éta: The Numerologists of the Thousand Sons were members of the Order of Ruin, which filled a role similar to that of the Techmarines in other Legions. They were also renowned for their tactical acuity, devising strategies and influencing the course of battle. Much of their success could be attributed to the psychic abilities of the Numerologists, who employed both divination and telepathy to predict enemy movements and relay these changes to their allies. A Model with this Special Rule has the following Psychic Powers, but a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule cannot be assigned a Prosperine Arcana as normal. In addition, it has the Telepath and Diviner Traits: Blessing of Prescience (Divination Discipline), Mind-Burst (Telepathy Discipline).
Les objectifs avancent secteur par secte: The objectives advance sector by sector towards the Defender's edge; the other marked positions are the sector centres they can occupy.
Les objectifs démarrent au centre des se: The objectives start at the centre of the sectors shown on the map. When an objective advances, its value increases by 1 (maximum 3), then it moves one sector, with no diagonal movement. If no move is possible, it stays in place but can still increase up to 3.
Les objectifs sont placés au centre des: The objectives are placed at the centre of the sectors shown and advance as in the other Onslaught missions: +1 value (maximum 3), then a move of one sector towards the Defender's edge, with no diagonals.
Les officiers les plus haut gradés d'une: The highest-ranking officers of an army.

Les ogives qui creusent la terre se moqu: Burrowing warheads care little for cover. No Cover Saves or Shrouded Damage Mitigation Rolls can be made against a Wound or Penetrating Hit inflicted by a Weapon with this Special Rule (Armour Saves and Invulnerable Saves can still be made). Against a Vehicle, its Hits always target the Side Armour Facing. It can never target a Model with the Flyer Sub-type. Against a Unit whose Models are in an area of terrain with several levels, its Hits can only be allocated to Models on the lowest level.
Les origines des escouades de Destructeu: The origins of Destroyer squads date back to the Unification Wars of Terra, but perhaps surprisingly not on the side of the Emperor's forces, rather on that of his enemies. Considered dishonourable by some Legions, which make only limited use of them or avoid them entirely, Destroyers are equipped with an otherwise proscribed arsenal and have mastered its use. Alongside certain factions of the Mechanicum, only the Destroyer cohorts are licensed to use such prohibited devices. Rad weapons and the creeping, burning horror of phosphex are among their dark arsenal — weapons that irrevocably taint the ground on which they are used.
Les plus anciens de leur espèce, ce sont: The most senior of their kind, Forge Lords oversee the accords binding their Legion to the various factions of the Mechanicum, including the sinister magi of the Ordo Reductor. Many therefore go to war accompanied by a cohort of Thallax cyborgs bearing the Legion's heraldry, charged with overseeing these troops, whether they are the fruit of a simple exchange or a token of respect bequeathed at the end of a joint campaign. This Special Rule allows Thallax Units to be selected within a Detachment that includes a Forge Lord. When a Model with this Special Rule is included in a Detachment, two additional Force Organisation Slots are added to that Detachment. These Slots may only be filled by Thallax Cohort Units chosen from the Liber Mechanicum (not transcribed on this site). When such a Unit is included in this way, the Reductor Trait of all of its Models is replaced by "Bound Reductor", and the Aegis of Suffering Special Rule is removed from them. These Units may be included even if they do not have the same Faction Trait as the other Units in that Detachment.
Les plus belliqueux serviteurs de Tzeent: The most bellicose servants of Tzeentch serve their patron god as the champions and headtakers of the Lord of Paths. Showered not only with the many gifts granted to other servants, the Ascendant Lords are imbued with supernaturally heightened talents in the arts of war. With these, they are tasked with leading the hordes of Tzeentch to war in place of a Lord of Change, or else swear to guard the Greater Daemons against the troublesome interference of their enemies while they observe and weave the many skeins of reality.
Les plus grands des osts démoniaques de: The greatest of the daemonic hosts of Slaanesh are known to Imperial forces as "Keepers of Secrets", on account of their tempting whispers. Most often they take a humanoid form, but frequently possess goat-like lower limbs and cranial features. In defiance of the natural order of things, these manifestations have also been seen with limbs extended into razor-edged sickle-claws, able to move with improbable grace, resulting in an aesthetic dissonance sickening to behold.
Les plus redoutables guerriers d'une arm: The most formidable warriors of an army.
Les plus redoutables guerriers d’une arm: The most fearsome warriors of an army.
Les portes du véhicule sont ouvertes dès: The vehicle's doors are open from the moment it is deployed; any embarked unit must disembark immediately, and no one can embark afterwards.
Les pouvoirs d'un Navigateur comptent pa: The powers of a Navigator are among the mightiest of all the Psyker castes, though they are rarely overtly offensive in nature. When pushed to the brink, however, Navigators are capable of channelling the tides of the Empyrean and turning them against their enemies. A Model with this Special Rule has a specific Psychic Discipline: it has the Navis Astrologis Psychic Discipline, which grants it the Lidless Stare Psychic Weapon and the "Navis Astrologian" Trait.
Les Preux Martiaux représentent la norme: Martial Gallants are the standard on which the Unit Profiles of the Questoris Familia Army List are based: this Advantage does not modify the profile of any Model in a Unit for which it is selected. Unlocks the Support Banner Additional Detachment.

Les primarques et une poignée de puissan: The Primarchs and a handful of mighty warriors. No more than 25% of your points limit may be spent on Warlord + Lord of War.
Les Procurateurs avec Jump Pack portent: Procurators with Jump Packs carry their scavenging rites directly into the heart of the melee, swooping down on the enemy from the skies.
Les Procurateurs ratissaient le champ de: The Procurators scoured the battlefield in search of organic components, harvested from the dead, to fuel profane rituals; organs won in single combat held a particular power, drawing the attention of the most powerful and aggressive creatures of the Warp. A Model with this Special Rule may gain Flesh Harvest Points: it gains 1 each time a Unit that includes it is selected to Consolidate, if enemy Models in that Combat had the Infantry or Cavalry Type (2 instead if a Model with the Paragon Type was Removed as a Casualty during that Combat). If a Model with Flesh Harvest Points is Removed as a Casualty, it loses all of its Flesh Harvest Points. During the Determine Victor Step, at the end of the Battle, the Controlling Player of any Models with this Special Rule scores a number of Victory Points equal to the number of Flesh Harvest Points held by one of those Models, chosen by them.
Les Procurateurs traquent l'ennemi jusqu: Procurators hunt the enemy to the farthest reaches of the battlefield to harvest from still-warm bodies the organic components needed for the dark rites of the Word Bearers.
Les Psykers peuvent être sélectionnés co: Psykers may be selected as Conduits to modify the Line (X) value of friendly or enemy Units. At the start of each Victory Sub-Phase, the Controlling Player of at least one Model on the battlefield with this Special Rule may nominate a friendly or enemy Unit. They must then select a Conduit: a friendly Model with both the Psyker Trait and this Special Rule, that has not already been a Conduit during this Battle Turn, that is not Locked in Combat and is not subject to any Tactical Status, and make a Willpower Check using the Conduit's Willpower. If the Check is passed, all Models in the nominated Unit lose any variant of Vanguard (X) and gain the Line (1) Special Rule, or have any variant of Line (X) they already have modified by +1, to a maximum of Line (3), until the end of the current Victory Sub-Phase; the Controlling Player may then select a new Conduit and repeat this process. Les quatre symboles marquent les emplace: The four symbols mark the possible Warp Rift locations: the Defender places up to two, only one per location.
Les raids ne cherchent pas toujours à co: Raids do not always seek to conquer a world; sometimes it is enough to strip it of everything that still allowed it to survive.
Les Rapaces Nocturnes sont moins une for: The Night Raptors are less an elite force than a coterie of murderers united by shared preferences and methods of combat. The Night Raptors take a wicked joy in soaring over the battlefield like birds of prey in search of victims and relish the dreadful moment of lucidity that seizes a victim when they see death swooping down upon them. In battle, they adorn themselves with morbid trophies and drape themselves in the flayed skin of their victims, to strike dread into their foes.
Les rectangles pleins sont les grandes p: The solid rectangles are the large doors between sectors; their exact position depends on the terrain layout. The Defender arrives in waves in sectors Beta, Gamma or Delta.

Les Règles Spéciales Phage (X) et Empois: The Phage (X) and Poisoned (X) Special Rules have no effect on a Model with this Special Rule: the effects of all variants of these two Special Rules are ignored when targeting a Model with this Special Rule.
Les Réserves du Défenseur peuvent entrer: The Defender's Reserves may enter from either short edge, not only from their own table edge.

Models in Reserves cannot be selected or attacked during any player's turn, but do not count as Removed as Casualties. They are kept near the table, apart from casualties, and must be known to all players.
Les Salamanders de Vulkan enfoncent le f: Vulkan's Salamanders smash into the left flank of the Death Guard line, in the Urgall Depression.
Les Salamanders doivent suivre les ordre: The Salamanders must follow Vulkan's orders and push their assault through the Ignis sector defences held by the Death Guard. Every step of their inexorable advance follows in the bloody footsteps of their Saturnine-armoured brothers. They must strike the traitor's line before the moment of betrayal arrives.
Les Sauvegardes d'Armure et Invulnérable: Successful Armour Saves and Invulnerable Saves can inflict Tactical Statuses on enemy Models. At the end of Step 4 of the Assault Phase, if any Model in Gorgon pattern Terminator Armour has passed at least one Armour Save or Invulnerable Save against Wounds caused by Shooting or Melee Attacks in the same Assault Phase, the Unit that inflicted those Wounds must take a Cool Check. Les sections de techniciens de combat so: Combat technician sections are specialists rarely seen within the cohorts, though each keeps a small number on hand for deployment when needed. Kept away from the front lines to sift intelligence and tactical data, their expertise is sometimes required to identify and interrogate captured enemy operators, or to interpret devices not sanctioned by the Mechanicum. Equipped with an array of technological devices, technicians are not fazed by the enemy's technical means.
Les Sekhmet étaient l'élite des Thousand: The Sekhmet were the elite of the Thousand Sons, and Magnus's personal guard. Clad in Terminator Armour, all were initiates of the Prosperine Mysteries who had sublimated their faculties and emotions to reach the pinnacle of spiritual control. Identified by the jade scarab fixed to their armour, they formed a brotherhood within the brotherhood. Able to raise their minds to the highest levels of the Enumerations, the Scarab Occult fought with such coordination and discipline that they seemed less warriors of flesh and blood than automata fashioned in the image of man.
Les Serments se cochent directement sur: Oaths are ticked directly on the card of the relevant Primary/Allied Detachment (“Force organisation” section below), with an “Attached to” menu on each Auxiliary/ Apex Detachment to choose whose Oaths it inherits. Les seules émotions que les Mort-jurés p: The only emotions the Deathsworn can still feel are those of slaughter and of the death that awaits them. The Deathsworn make one last attack before being Removed as Casualties. At Initiative Step 1 of any Combat that involves at least one Model with this Special Rule, the Controlling Player may make a bonus attack for each Model with this Special Rule that was Removed as a Casualty at any previous Initiative Step of the current Combat. These attacks can target any Unit involved in that Combat, and are made using the Agony strike profile.
Les Sodalités de Gardes Sentinelles se d: Sentinel Guard Sodalities deploy mainly to protect emissaries in dangerous territory and to hold defensive positions against the worst assaults, bearing their so-called "Praesidium" force field shields, precursors of their counterparts in service with the Legiones Astartes, able to endure the most violent salvoes. Beyond this protective role, by virtue of the physical prowess of every Custodian and the unequalled equipment with which they are furnished, the Sentinel Guard are mobile enough to play far more aggressive roles in battle, all the more so as their resilience makes them terrible line-breakers.
Les Solar Auxilia entretiennent des cadr: The Solar Auxilia maintain cadres of trained medicae, assigned to the Units that will stand closest to the fighting. Though lacking the advanced equipment of Legion Apothecaries, these healers are no less devoted to the protection of their brothers-in-arms, even in the deadliest exchanges of fire. Auxilia medicae deploy and operate individually. Although included in an Army as a Unit of several Models, each Model with this Special Rule is treated as a separate Unit for all purposes, including Deployment and the counting of Victory Points.
Les Sons of Horus font les Attaques de V: Sons of Horus make Volley Attacks using their full Ballistic Skill Characteristic.
Les Sons of Horus se montraient relative: The Sons of Horus were relatively unfussy in their recruitment practices, operating as they did at the cutting edge of the civil war. Their most valiant Inductii, however, were drawn from worlds whose gang traditions mirrored those of Cthonia, ensuring that these new Legionaries already understood the culture of strength and the need to prove their worth in the eyes of their superiors.
Les souverains démoniaques exercent une: Daemonic sovereigns wield authority over their hordes of subordinates and pursue designs that go beyond mere destruction. Their forms vary infinitely, but all share an imposing stature and a terrifying aspect. Many of them have earned titles and legends by carving bloody furrows across the stars, terrors that still haunt the nightmares of History.
Les Space Wolves font un Mouvement de Po: Space Wolves make a longer Set-up Move.
Les Space Wolves n'ont jamais rechigné f: The Space Wolves never shied away from frontal yet bloody assaults. This Detachment's Troops Slots may only be used to select Grey Slayer Pack Units.
Les strato-vox sont des terminaux de com: Strato-voxes are high-gain command and control terminals, able to coordinate with the guidance systems of Drop Pods and other drop craft, and even teleportariums, automatically adjusting arrival coordinates in real time as the target approaches the battlefield, ensuring the precise deployment of supporting forces. While at least one Model equipped with a Strato-vox is on the battlefield, before making a Reserves Test for a Unit in Reserves that includes Models with the Deep Strike Special Rule, the Controlling Player may choose to activate that Strato-vox. If they do, that Reserves Test is automatically passed, but the Unit for which it was activated must make a Deep Strike instead of deploying normally.
Les super-lourds loyalistes des Iron War: The Loyalist Iron Warriors super-heavies charge to turn back the invasion of the Mechanicum and the Alpha Legion.
Les Suzerains jouissent déjà d'une indis: Suzerains already enjoy unquestioned authority among the lower ranks of the Legion, not through force or the fear they inspire, but through respect and admiration. Friendly Models in range can use this Model's Characteristics to remove a Tactical Status from themselves. In the Statuses Sub-Phase, for any friendly Unit that includes no Models with the Vehicle Type and that has at least one Model within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule that is not itself subject to a Tactical Status, the unmodified Characteristic of the Model with this Special Rule can be used for Checks to remove Tactical Statuses from that Unit.
Les Taghmata du Mechanicum utilisent le: The Mechanicum Taghmata use the same Crusade Force Organisation Chart as the Legiones Astartes.
Les techniques de guérison sorcières des: The sorcerous healing techniques of the Davinite lodges are held in deep suspicion, for it is whispered that they may have played a part in Horus' turn to treachery. A Model with this Special Rule has the Resurrection Psychic Reaction, from the Thaumaturgy Psychic Discipline.
Les textes de règles sont des <strong>re: The rules texts are summarised transcriptions intended for beginners. Les Tireurs de Runes tiennent leurs pouv: Casters of Runes draw their powers from psychic matrices of ill-understood technology, but also from the rituals of Fenris, for they are the heirs of their planet's shamanic cultures.
Les Touches Pénétrantes qu'infligent des: Penetrating Hits inflicted by attacks with this Special Rule can cause additional Hits. At the end of Step 9 of the Shooting Attack process, or at Step 8 of the Resolve an Initiative Step process, for a Fire Group or Strike Group that includes Weapons with this Special Rule and that has inflicted at least one Penetrating Hit, a new Fire Group or Strike Group (respectively) is created, resolved in the following Step. This new Group consists of a number of Hits equal to the number of Hull Points lost by the Target Model because of the triggering Group; these Hits all have a Strength equal to the value of X, an AP of "-", a Damage of 1 and no Special Rules.
Les Transporteurs Thunderhawk sont équip: Thunderhawk Transporters are fitted with flexible frames, able to rapidly deliver various Legiones Astartes vehicles to battle, while also assisting in their recovery and that of other heavy materiel. A Thunderhawk Transporter can carry certain Models with the Vehicle Type in addition to Infantry. In addition to any other Models Embarked on a Model with this Special Rule, it may also have one of the following Embarked on it: up to two Rhino Models, or one Land Raider Carrier or Land Raider Explorator Model.

Les Ultramarines déployaient leurs force: The Ultramarines deployed their forces according to various standardised formations. This Detachment's Command Slot may only be used to select an Optae Unit.
Les Ultramarines marquent 5 points de vi: The Ultramarines score 5 victory points if they still hold it at that moment.
Les Unités à 8 pouces d'une Figurine enn: Units within 8" of an enemy Model equipped with a Magisterium vexilla must pass a Leadership Check when they score an Objective, or score only a single Victory Point. In the Victory Sub-Phase of any End Phase, when a Unit with at least one Model within 8" and in Line of Sight of an enemy Model equipped with a Magisterium vexilla would score Victory Points for Controlling or Contesting an Objective, it must first make a Leadership Check. If it is passed, there is no further effect; if it is failed, the Unit may only score a single Victory Point for Controlling or Contesting the Objective in that Victory Sub-Phase, regardless of other Special Rules such as Line (X) or Comptroller (X).
Les unités chargées de convoyer les trou: The units charged with ferrying vulnerable troops.
Les Unités de Salamanders peuvent ignore: Salamanders Units may ignore Tactical Status Tests caused by Flame Weapons.
Les unités désignées comme Tekathikos ga: Units designated as Tekathikos gain a house-rule advantage against buildings and fortifications: for example +1 to damage buildings in close combat, or a re-roll of failed rolls against gates and ramparts.
Les unités du Défenseur ne marquent pas: The Defender's units do not score simply by controlling objectives: they lose Line (X), gain Vanguard (2) if needed, then become eligible to score under certain conditions.
Les unités ennemies à 12 pouces subissen: Enemy units within 12" suffer a penalty of X to their Leadership, Cool, Willpower and Intelligence Characteristics.
Les Unités ennemies en Combat avec une U: Enemy Units in Combat with a Unit with this Special Rule must pass a Willpower Check before an Aftermath option is selected for them. If a Combat includes Models with this Special Rule, their Controlling Player may choose to have the opposing Player make a Willpower Check for each of their Units in the selected Combat, before choosing an Aftermath option for that Unit. If the Check is passed, the Player may choose an Aftermath option normally; if it is failed, they must choose Hold. If a Unit includes Models with the Routed Status, a Willpower Check must still be made for it: if it is passed, the Unit must Fall Back; if it is failed, it must Hold, but its Models keep the Routed Status, whatever the result.

Parmi la plupart des Legiones Astartes,: Among most of the Legiones Astartes, the main role of heavy support squads is to saturate an enemy area or target under a deluge of fire, obliterating the foe with sheer firepower. The Iron Havocs of the IV Legion, however, are an elite formation that has raised these tactics almost to an art. These warriors are among the finest marksmen of the Iron Warriors, combining precise shell and explosive fire as they advance alongside the Legion's assault cadres. Iron Havocs are often attached to the spearhead elements of any assault, where their unequalled accuracy lets them clear enemy fortifications and infantry strongpoints with deadly efficiency, paving the way for the Iron Warriors to then sweep away any survivors.
Parmi la XIIe Légion, ceux qui arboraien: Within the XII Legion, those who proudly bore the mark of the bloody hand — or, as some called it, the "butcher's mark" — upon their armour were known among their brothers as Red Hand squads. As the Horus Heresy raged, these squads invariably took their place in the vanguard, howling their bloodlust to prove themselves ever more worthy of bearing this gory adornment. Those who faced them in battle knew that crossing blades with one of these marked warriors meant a brutal and bloody death.
Parmi les Ordres du Cercle Intérieur de: Among the Orders of the Inner Circle of the I Legion, that of the Broken Claws had the fewest adherents, but not for lack of importance. They were charged with recording the account of the battles fought against the dreaded Rangda and, in the wake of that xenos strain's destruction, these knights were charged with guarding the spoils of those victories. As the events of the Horus Heresy unfolded, the duties of the Order of the Broken Claws were extended, small groups guarding stasis vaults containing relics taken from the I Legion's defeated enemies, preventing them from falling into the hands of those who opposed the Imperium.
Parmi les plus grandes créatures que l'o: Among the largest creatures encountered within the Ruinstorm hordes, these great beasts often manifest as misshapen, mutated parodies of natural life, such as monstrous lizards or canine giants. Others defy all reason, taking the form of heaps of teeming flesh and fangs, or masses of sinuous limbs crowned with eyes and maws. Whatever their form, these Daemons prove deadly foes, able to absorb considerable damage while bearing down on the enemy lines. When they reach the enemy, they shatter formations, tear open fortifications and trample infantry.
Parmi les plus nombreux des osts de Slaa: Among the most numerous of the hosts of Slaanesh to assail the realspace of the Imperium are the lesser Daemons that the Imperial troops who first saw them in battle named "Daemonettes". Humanoid in appearance but with aberrant clawed appendages and smooth horned protrusions on their skulls, these forms prowl the battlefield in overexcited packs, seeking out concentrations of troops to engage in close combat.
Parmi les Primarques, Magnus le Rouge ét: Among the Primarchs, Magnus the Red was the undisputed master of the mystic arts. In psychic power he was second only to the Emperor, and some even believe that certain of his secrets were beyond his father's reach. Magnus is blessed with several Prosperine Arcana. A Model with this Special Rule is considered to know the Raptora, Pyrae, Pavoni, Corvidae and Athanaean Prosperine Arcana.
Parodies horrifiantes des prédateurs des: Horrifying parodies of the predators of the deepest and coldest oceans, the Screamers of Tzeentch glide through the air as if swimming, borne up by an unnatural force. They are drawn to war and violence as hunters to the scent of blood, in search of prey to feast upon. Despite their seemingly aimless behaviour, the many-fanged maws and barbed spines of a large, frenzied shoal of Screamers can prove more than formidable, even for the most capable warriors.

Each Model in each of the selected Units gains the Deep Strike Special Rule and the Warp Rift Trait for the duration of the Battle. During one of their Reserves Sub-Phases, the Controlling Player of a Model with this Special Rule may select a friendly Model with this Special Rule that is not Locked in Combat to open a warp rift; if they do, they may then select a Unit from their Army that is in Reserves and that includes only Models with the Warp Rift Trait. Reserves Rolls made for that Unit during that Sub-Phase are automatically passed and the Unit makes a Deep Strike as normal, with two exceptions: the first Model of the Unit must be placed in Base Contact with the Model that opened the warp rift, and a Charge may be declared for the Unit during the Charge Sub-Phase of that same Player Turn.

Permet aux Automates d'effectuer des Réa: Allows Automata to make Reactions. A Unit that includes any Models with the Automata Type may ignore the restriction on Reactions that the Automata Type imposes, as long as it includes at least one Model with a cortex controller.
Permet aux Figurines d'ignorer le malus: Allows Models to ignore the Movement penalty for Difficult Terrain. If the Controlling Player moves a Model equipped with a dozer blade into any area of Difficult Terrain, that Unit does not have to apply a modifier to its movement in that Phase.
Permet aux figurines de Type Automate de: Allows models with the Automata Type in the unit to declare Reactions, which they are normally forbidden from doing.
Permet aux Unités de retirer des Statuts: Allows Units to remove Tactical Statuses in the Start Phase. If a Unit includes at least one Model equipped with a nuncio-vox, and there is at least one Model with the Command Sub-type on the Battlefield, the Controlling Player may activate the nuncio-vox in the Start Phase of their Turn as the Active Player. When the nuncio-vox is activated, the Controlling Player may make a Check to remove a single Tactical Status from all Models in the Unit equipped with the nuncio-vox. This Check is made using the Cool Characteristic (except when attempting to remove the Routed Status, in which case Leadership is used) of any friendly Model with the Command Sub-type on the Battlefield, chosen by the Controlling Player. A nuncio-vox can only be activated once per Turn, and each friendly Model with the Command Sub-type can only be used for this Special Rule once per Start Phase.
Permet d'utiliser deux fois la Règle Spé: Allows the Battlesmith (X) Special Rule to be used twice in the same Turn. Each time the Controlling Player of a Model equipped with a machinator array chooses to use the Battlesmith (X) Special Rule, they may use it twice, on the same Target Unit or on two different Target Units, with possibly different effects (all targets must be valid).
Permet de faire des Jets de Rétablisseme: Allows Recovery Tests to be made in the Morale Sub-Phase. If a Unit that includes any Model equipped with a narthecium is not Locked in Combat, before the Controlling Player makes a Characteristic Check for that Unit in the Morale Sub-Phase, they may make a Recovery Test for the Unit. If this Recovery Test is passed, the Player may subtract 2 from the result of the Characteristic Check. Only one Recovery Test can be made in this way per Unit in each Morale Sub-Phase.
Permet de porter des attaques plus préci: Allows more accurate attacks to be made with Barrage Weapons. Instead of making a Shooting Attack with a Model equipped with a cognis-signum, the Controlling Player may make an Intelligence Check. If the Check is passed, they may choose a single enemy Unit in Line of Sight of the Model equipped with the cognis-signum: the next time in the current Shooting Phase that the chosen enemy Unit is targeted by a Shooting Attack that includes at least one Weapon with the Barrage (X) Special Rule, the Controlling Player may make Hit Tests for those attacks as normal, ignoring the limitations of the Barrage (X) Special Rule if the Unit making the Shooting Attack does not have Line of Sight to the Target Unit. If the Check is failed, the cognis-signum has no effect this turn.
Permet de remplacer en urgence un maréch: Allows a fallen marshal to be replaced in an emergency. The Reactive Player, controlling Units made up solely of models with the Skitarii Trait, may declare it once per Battle when a friendly Skitarii Combat Peregrine Marshal model is reduced to 0 Wounds (cost: 1 Reaction Allotment, paid upon declaration).
Permet de retirer des Statuts à la Phase: Allows Statuses to be removed in the Start Phase. If a friendly Model on the Battlefield is equipped with a command vox, the Controlling Player may activate an internodal vox once per Player Turn to remove a single Status from all Models in the Unit equipped with that internodal vox.

Allows Statuses to be removed in the Start Phase. A command vox acts as a relay for friendly internodal voxes: each friendly Model on the Battlefield equipped with a command vox may only be used for this Special Rule once per Start Phase.
Permet de sélectionner un nombre de Déta: Allows a number of Auxiliary Detachments equal to X to be selected for the relevant Command Slot, instead of only one.
Permet de tirer sur une cible sans ligne: Allows the weapon to fire at a target without Line of Sight (indirect fire). Combined with Blast, a Scatter roll determines where the shot lands if it misses.

Perturabo était connu pour utiliser Le T: Perturabo was known to use The Tormentor as a mobile command centre, his automata bodyguard housed in specially modified transport compartments within its hull while he directed his forces. Only Perturabo or Domitar-Ferrum Models can Embark on a Model with this Special Rule.
Perturabo s'intéressait rarement aux not: Perturabo rarely concerned himself with notions of honour on the battlefield, devoting himself instead to the grim mathematics of slaughter. Even when an enemy champion sought to goad him into a duel, Perturabo would often prefer to order his troops to riddle the upstart with bolts rather than lower himself to strike them down personally. This Reaction allows a friendly Unit to make a Shooting Attack targeting a Model in a Challenge with Perturabo. While a Model with this Special Rule is in a Challenge, its Controlling Player may choose this Gambit: The Breaker — this Gambit can only be chosen in the first Face-Off Step of a Challenge. If it adopts this Gambit, this Model does not make attacks in the following Strike Step; instead, the Controlling Player of this Model may choose a single friendly Unit composed of Models with the Iron Warriors Trait, within 12" of the enemy Model involved in this Challenge and not Locked in Combat, and make a Shooting Attack with that Unit. The attacks are resolved as Snap Shots, cannot use Weapons with the Blast (X) Special Rule or the Template Range Characteristic, and Wounds from this Shooting Attack can only be allocated to the opposing Model in the Challenge.
Petites armes (autocanon, canon à bolts: Small weapons (Autocannon, Bolt cannon or Defensor lascannon): useful against infantry.
Peu d'individus sont capables d'assurer: Few individuals are capable of tirelessly maintaining, cataloguing, requisitioning and distributing the vast arsenals of an entire Legiones Astartes. Beyond this task, many of these Legion officers strive to improve the weaponry at their disposal, conducting simulations and field trials of new and advanced armaments. The skills required of an Armistos are highly sought after by the Legion's Master of the Arsenal, particularly among Legionaries of a thoughtful temperament, little inclined to charge into the melee but able to support and resupply their battle-brothers without desire for personal glory.
Peu de gens en dehors des forge-artisans: Few outside the most ancient forge-artisans of the Ironwing know anything of the Excindio class automata, colossal metal monsters cast in an inhuman mould and unleashed only upon the most intransigent of enemies. A maelstrom of whirling claws and jets of flame and radiation, few formations can stand against one of these monstrosities once it is unleashed on the battlefield, for an Excindio knows neither pity nor restraint, and unlike the coldly logical automata of the Mechanicum, it takes vicious pleasure in the carnage it inflicts on the enemy. This Unit may only be included in Detachments from the Legiones Astartes Army List whose Primary Detachment has the Dark Angels Faction; it cannot be selected in an Allied Detachment.
Peu de guerriers de la XIXe Légion appré: Few warriors of the XIX Legion favoured the use of Terminator armour, and its regular deployment was generally the preserve of Terran veterans who had long served in the shadow of the Luna Wolves. Many of them had fought alongside the infamous Justaerin, and had mastered the tactics of the close-quarters shock assault. The legionaries of the Raven Guard and the Luna Wolves came to nickname these warriors the "Deliverers", as much for the carnage they inflicted on the enemy as for their tendency to be deployed when other assaults by the XIX Legion became bogged down, turning the tide of battle with a merciless onslaught of bolt and blade. 0-1: only one Deliverers Squad is permitted per Army.

Plus rares que leurs homologues des Esco: Rarer than their Tactical and Assault Squad counterparts in most Legions, Breacher Veterans typically operated as a heavy assault force, employed offensively as line breakers and defensively as an elite reserve. These capabilities most often saw them deployed in so-called "Zone Mortalis" environments, their wargear granting them the resilience needed to endure such hellish war zones, while their mastery of combat — acquired over decades at the forefront of the Great Crusade — allowed them to cut even the most hardened foes to pieces.

Posture de Défi de Hibou Khan (White Sca: Gambit of Hibou Khan (White Scars) that allows him to attempt to avoid being Removed as a Casualty. While a Model with this Special Rule is Engaged in a Challenge, its Controlling Player may choose this Gambit: if this Model is reduced to 0 Wounds during Step 4 of the Strike Step, its Controlling Player may roll a dice — on a 4+, this Model is not Removed as a Casualty, but remains Engaged in the Challenge with a Wounds Characteristic of 1, and its Controlling Player gains the Challenge Advantage.
Posture de Défi de la Legio Custodes dis: Legio Custodes Gambit available while a Model with the Legio Custodes Trait is Engaged in a Challenge. This Gambit grants a Model additional attacks based on the number of enemy Models involved in the same Combat. If this Gambit is chosen, and the Opposing Player has a higher Outside Support bonus than the Controlling Player during the Focus Step, the Model that adopts it gains a bonus to its current Attacks Characteristic in the following Strike Step equal to the difference between the Players' Outside Support bonuses in that Challenge, up to a maximum of +3.
Posture de Défi de la Legio Custodes qui: Legio Custodes Gambit that limits a Model to a single attack, but whose Damage Characteristic is set to the Model's remaining Wounds. If this Gambit is chosen, the Model that adopts it may only make a single attack in the following Strike Step, regardless of its Attacks Characteristic, but the Damage Characteristic of the Weapon used for that attack is modified to equal the Current Value of the Model's Wounds Characteristic while resolving that attack.

Legio Custodes Gambit that halves the Model's Attacks Characteristic, but replaces the Critical Hit (6+) Special Rule with Critical Hit (5+) on its Weapon. If this Gambit is chosen, as long as the Model that adopts it declared at the start of the Focus Step that it is using a Weapon with the Critical Hit (6+) Special Rule, that rule is replaced by the Critical Hit (5+) Special Rule, and the Model's base Attacks Characteristic is halved for the duration of the Strike Step.
Posture de Défi de la Legio Custodes, ré: Legio Custodes Gambit, restricted to a Model with the Shield Trait, that modifies a Model's Toughness by +1 but causes Wound Tests made for it to automatically fail on a natural roll of 1 or 2. If this Gambit is chosen, the Model that adopts it gains a +1 modifier to its Toughness Characteristic for the duration of the Strike Step, but all Wound Tests made for that Model in the same Strike Step automatically fail on a natural roll of 1 or 2.
Posture de Défi des Solar Auxilia qui pe: Solar Auxilia Challenge Gambit that allows a Model to respond with a pistol rather than in close combat. A Model engaged in a Challenge that has the Solar Auxilia Trait may choose this Gambit to make a single Shooting Attack with a pistol against the enemy Model in the Challenge, whose Wounds may only be allocated to that Model. If this Shooting Attack Removes it as a Casualty, proceed directly to the Glory Step without a Focus Roll; otherwise, the opponent automatically gains the Challenge Advantage.
Posture de Défi qui augmente la Caractér: Gambit that increases the Model's Attacks Characteristic and grants a bonus to the result of a Focus Roll made for it in a Challenge, at the cost of automatic Wounds. While a Model with this Special Rule is Engaged in a Challenge, its Controlling Player must adopt the Biological Overload Gambit; any Special Rule or Gambit that would prevent this is ignored. Biological Overload: if this Gambit is chosen, the Controlling Player gains a +3 modifier to their Focus Roll in the following Focus Step, and this Model's Attacks Characteristic is modified by +3 for the duration of the following Strike Step. However, for each roll of 1 on a Hit Test made for this Model's Attacks in that Strike Step, the Model suffers an Unsaved Wound with a Damage of 1, allocated at the end of the Strike Step.
Posture disponible à Corvus Corax tant q: A Gambit available to Corvus Corax while he is Engaged in a Challenge: he fights as if he had lost no Wounds (negative modifiers to the Focus Roll due to a Wounds Characteristic lower than his Base Value are ignored), provided he chooses Talionis at the start of the Focus Step. If he inflicts at least one successful Hit with Talionis in the Strike Step as the Active Player, he may move to the Glory Step as soon as Step 4 is resolved, even without Challenge Advantage.
Posture disponible à Hibou Khan tant qu': A Gambit available to Hibou Khan while he is Engaged in a Challenge: if this Gambit is chosen and he is reduced to 0 Wounds in Step 4 of the Strike Step, his Controlling Player rolls a dice — on a 4+, he is not Removed as a Casualty and remains Engaged in the Challenge with a Wounds Characteristic of 1, and his Controlling Player gains Challenge Advantage.
Posture disponible à une Figurine qui a: Gambit available to a Model with this Special Rule while it is engaged in a Challenge. If it is chosen, the Controlling Player rolls an additional dice in the Focus Step and discards the highest result; then, in the Strike Step, the Model makes a Shooting Attack with its Liquifractor before the protagonist and antagonist make any attacks. This Shooting Attack must target the enemy Model in the Challenge and all Wounds inflicted must be allocated to it; it is treated as being at a range of 1" and in Line of Sight.
Posture disponible tant qu'une Figurine: A Gambit available while a Model with this Special Rule is Engaged in a Challenge: in the Strike Step, the Strength of attacks made by the enemy Model is modified by -1 if the Current Value of its Wounds Characteristic is lower than its Base Value (never reducing the Strength of an attack to a value lower than 1).

A Gambit available while a Model with this Special Rule is Engaged in a Challenge: the Controlling Player of this Model cannot apply any positive modifiers to the Focus Roll in Step 4 of the Strike Step. However, if this Model is not reduced to 0 Wounds before the players return to Step 2 of the Challenge procedure or move on to the Glory Step, it increases the value of its Current Wounds Characteristic by +D3, up to its Base Wounds Characteristic. Any Wounds regained through this Special Rule do not affect the number of Wounds the Opponent has inflicted for Combat Resolution.

A Gambit available while a Model with this Special Rule is Engaged in a Challenge: if it is chosen, the Controlling Player of this Model gains a positive modifier to their Focus Roll equal to the number of Hit Tests their opponent passed in the previous Strike Step of the current Challenge (no effect if no Strike Step has yet been resolved).

A Gambit available while a Model with this Special Rule is Engaged in a Challenge, only before the first Focus Roll of a Challenge and only if the Model made a successful Charge in the same Assault Phase: in the following Focus Step, the Controlling Player gains a positive modifier to the Focus Roll equal to the variant of Bulky (X) that the enemy Model Engaged in the Challenge with it has.
Posture qui permet à Rogal Dorn de se ba: A Gambit that allows Rogal Dorn to fight defensively. While a Model with this Special Rule is Engaged in a Challenge, its Controlling Player may choose this Gambit: Bulwark of the Imperium — while this Gambit is chosen, Wound Tests made against the Model adopting this Gambit with an unmodified result of 1, 2, 3 or 4 always fail, regardless of the Strength Characteristic of a Hit and regardless of any Special Rules that set the Target Number for Wound Tests.

Pour l’emporter, les joueurs doivent tir: To win, the players must make the most of limited infantry support to keep their vehicles alive, while destroying their opponent's. The general rules of the Armoured Spearhead pack apply.
Pour les forces montées lors de missions: For mounted forces on reconnaissance or strike missions, Primus Medicae often requisition a Spatha bike or Scimitar Jetbike from the Legion armoury. While their role does not always allow for the precision and delicacy of such equipment, the ability to move quickly to wherever they are needed cannot be underestimated.
Pour les guerriers des Atramentar, aucun: For the warriors of the Atramentar, no act is beneath them, and any semblance of honourable combat has long since been abandoned. Seeking only to finish their foe in the most painful and ignominious manner possible, they use trickery and guile to deliver treacherous and underhanded attacks, never facing their opponent in a fair fight, even going so far as to push their own brothers in front of a killing blow to create an opening for a counter-attack. When the Controlling Player selects an enemy Unit that is already Locked in Combat as the Target of a Charge made by a Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule, the Models with this Special Rule modify their Set-up Move Distance by +1", to a maximum of 6", until that Charge Move has been resolved.
Pour les Légionnaires Iron Hands qui ava: For Iron Hands Legionaries who had failed the unbending standards and harsh code of their lord, by suffering defeat through a twist of fate or by being diminished by grievous wounds, one alternative remained if their record of service was not enough to spare them their brothers' contempt: to join the ranks of the Medusan Immortals.

Otherwise, the model is Removed as a Casualty.

Pouvoir Psychique (Bénédiction) : puisan: Psychic Power (Blessing): drawing upon the tormented depths of the Warp, the Diabolist bestows malefic blessings upon the Legionaries of the XVII, feeding them with dark energy while making them ever more monstrous in the eyes of their enemies. The Active Player may choose to Manifest it at the start of the Fight Sub-Phase of their Assault Phase; the Focus must be a Model with the Diabolist Trait under their control, and the Target Unit must be a Unit belonging to the Reactive Player with at least one Model within 12" of and in Line of Sight of the Focus, composed entirely of Models with the Word Bearers Trait. If the Manifestation is successful, all Models in the Target Unit gain the Aflame (1) and Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rules until the end of the Assault Phase.
Pouvoir Psychique (Bénédiction) de la Di: Psychic Power (Blessing) of the Anathemata Discipline, restricted to Models with the Traitor Trait: bending the entities of the Warp to their will, the Esoterist tears the fabric of reality to draw their extra-dimensional allies onto the battlefield. The Active Player may Manifest it at the start of the Reserves Sub-Phase of their Movement Phase; the Focus must be a Model with the Anathemata Trait under their control, and this Power has no Target. Make a Manifestation Check: if it is successful, the Active Player may choose a Unit from a Daemonic Manifestation Detachment in the same Army as the Focus that is in Reserves — its Reserves Rolls are automatically successful until the end of that Reserves Sub-Phase.
Pouvoir Psychique (Bénédiction) qui perm: Psychic Power (Blessing) that allows a Unit to inflict automatic Hits on any Unit that attacks it in melee. The Active Player may Manifest it at the end of the Declare Weapons and Set Initiative Steps Step of a Combat. The Focus must be a Model with the Pyrae Trait involved in that Combat; the Target is its Unit, composed entirely of Models with the Thousand Sons Trait. If successful, its effects last until the Combat is resolved: all Models in the Target Unit gain the Incandescent Shield Special Rule — at the end of each Initiative Step, any Unit that inflicted Hits on a Unit including at least one Model with this Special Rule suffers D6 Hits with a Strength of 4, an AP of - and a Damage of 1, allocated by the Controlling Player of the Unit suffering them.
Pouvoir Psychique (Bénédiction) qui rend: Psychic Power (Blessing) that makes the Unit's Shooting Attacks more effective. The Active Player may Manifest it in the Shooting Phase, at the start of Step 4 of a Shooting Attack made by a Unit including at least one Model with the Corvidae Trait. The Focus must be a Model with the Corvidae Trait in the shooting Unit; the Target is that same Unit, composed entirely of Models with the Thousand Sons Trait. If successful, its effects last until the end of the current Shooting Attack: all Ranged Weapons the Models in the Target Unit are equipped with, except those with the Blast (X) Special Rule, gain the Wounding (5+) Special Rule.
Pouvoir Psychique (Bénédiction) qui reti: Psychic Power (Blessing) that removes a Tactical Status from a friendly Unit. The Active Player may Manifest it in the Effects Sub-Phase of the Start Phase. The Focus must be a Model with the Athanaean Trait controlled by the Active Player; the Target is a friendly Unit, composed entirely of Models with the Thousand Sons Trait, with at least one Model within 18" of and in Line of Sight of the Focus. If successful, its effects are resolved immediately: the Controlling Player chooses a single Tactical Status affecting a Model in the Target Unit, and it is immediately removed from all Models in the Target Unit.
Pouvoir Psychique (Bénédiction), manifes: Psychic Power (Blessing), manifested in the Movement Phase: the Focus is a Model with the Stormseer Trait in the Unit that is about to Move; the Target is a friendly Unit composed entirely of Models with the White Scars Trait, within 12" and in Line of Sight of the Focus. If successful, the Target Unit cannot Rush this turn, but the Movement Characteristic of each of its Models is modified by a value equal to its own Initiative Characteristic for its normal Move this Phase.
Pouvoir Psychique (Malédiction) de la Di: Psychic Power (Curse) of the Rapture Discipline: if successful, the Target cannot make Reactions triggered by a Unit with the Slaanesh Trait. Trigger: the Active Player may Manifest it in any Phase. Focus: a Model with the Whisperer Trait controlled by the Active Player. Target: a Unit controlled by the Reactive Player with at least one Model within 18" of the Focus and in its Line of Sight. Duration: effects resolved immediately, for the duration of the current Player Turn. Process: the Controlling Player of the Target Unit makes a Resistance Check (a Model without Willpower is considered to have a base Willpower of 8). If it is failed, no Reaction may be declared for the Target Unit if the Unit triggering it includes Models with the Slaanesh Trait.
