Une Touche Pénétrante alloué à l’unité v: A Penetrating Hit allocated to the unit has its Damage modified by -1 (minimum 1).
Une unité <em>Neutralisée</em> (voir <a: A Suppressed unit (see Tactical Statuses) must use the "Snap Shots" row for all of its shooting — likewise for the Intercept Reaction, or a weapon fired by a unit with the Light trait after it has Rushed.
Une Unité composée uniquement de Figurin: A Unit composed only of Models with this Special Rule is immune to all variants of the Panic (X) Special Rule on Weapons with the Flame Trait.
Une Unité comprenant des Figurines possé: A Unit that includes Models with this Special Rule may only join, or be joined by, Models with this Special Rule.

A Unit that includes Models with this Special Rule can score Victory Points by destroying enemy Units. The Player controlling a Unit in which the majority of Models have the Vanguard (X) Special Rule scores a number of Victory Points equal to the value of X when: (1) an enemy Unit that is within 3" of an Objective Marker, or was at the start of the Player Turn, has its last model Removed as a Casualty by an attack made by this Unit; (2) an enemy Unit that is within 3" of an Objective Marker, or was at the start of the Player Turn, gains the Routed Tactical Status while in Combat with this Unit. If a Unit includes Models with different values of X for this Special Rule, the Controlling Player may choose which one is used. A Unit in which the majority of Models have the Vanguard (X) Special Rule can never score more than 1 Victory Point for Controlling an Objective, regardless of that Objective's value or any other bonus.
Une unité déployée ainsi ne peut ni se d: A unit deployed in this way cannot move in the Reposition Sub-phase of the same player turn, nor declare a Charge in its Charge Sub-phase, but may make Shooting Attacks normally. Enemy units may declare the Interceptor Reaction against it, but not the Reposition Reaction. A unit joined by another counts as a single unit for this rule.
Une unité éligible tire sur <strong>une: An eligible unit shoots at a single enemy unit, chosen from those that are visible and within reach — never a unit that is embarked, in Reserves, or already engaged in melee.
Une unité embarquée est traitée comme <s: An embarked unit is treated as temporarily out of play: it cannot be targeted by anything, makes no attacks or Reactions, and all effects it generates (such as Fear (X)) cease. Its statuses are kept but frozen until it disembarks, and nothing that affects the transport affects it… as long as it keeps rolling.
Une Unité ennemie qui Se Replie ne peut: An enemy Unit that Falls Back cannot be Pursued.
Une unité entièrement composée de figuri: A unit composed entirely of models with this rule gains a bonus of X" when Rushing, and of X to its Charge Roll.
A unit composed entirely of models with this rule can enter play from Reserves anywhere along the table edge (outside the enemy deployment zone and more than 7" from the enemy).
Une Unité entièrement composée de Figuri: A Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule ignores the penalties of Titanic Warhorn (X) and gains +1 Leadership while a friendly Titan is on the battlefield; it must take a Panic Check if a friendly Titan is destroyed.
A Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule can never Control or Contest an Objective, and cannot be chosen as the Target of a Charge while another enemy Unit is a valid Target.

A Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule cannot be targeted by a Shooting Attack in the first Battle Turn. A Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule cannot be chosen as the Target Unit of a Shooting Attack in the first Battle Turn. This Special Rule has no effect on Volley Attacks or on Shooting Attacks made as part of a Reaction.

A Unit composed entirely of Models with this Sub-type can never gain a Tactical Status, and can only be Rallied by a Model that can itself gain Tactical Statuses and become Routed; when it would gain a Tactical Status, it instead suffers D3 automatic Wounds (AP 2, Damage 1, no Saves allowed). Models with this Sub-type are not affected by Special Rules that negatively modify their Leadership, Willpower or Intelligence, and no Model that is not itself Malefic may join, or be joined by, such a Model.

A Unit composed entirely of Models with the Antigrav Sub-type ignores the effects of Terrain it moves over and may move over Impassable Terrain (without starting or ending its move there, and testing for Dangerous Terrain as normal if it starts or ends its move in it). It ignores Models and Units when it Moves, but must end its move at least 1" from any Model that is not part of the same Unit if it moves over a friendly Unit, or from any enemy Model if it moves over an enemy Unit.

A Unit composed entirely of Models with the Light Sub-type gains +2 to its Initiative when determining how far it can Rush (cumulative with other bonuses), and can make Shooting Attacks after Rushing, but only as Snap Shots.

A Unit composed entirely of Models with the Heavy Sub-type gains +1 Cool on Checks to avoid a Tactical Status. A Unit that includes any Model with the Heavy Sub-type cannot Rush, and uses only its Movement Characteristic — without adding its Initiative — for a Set-up Move.
A Unit composed entirely of Models with the Skirmish Sub-type has a Unit Coherency range of 3" instead of 2".

Une unité ne peut pas déclarer de charge: A unit cannot declare a charge if: it Rushed this turn; it is already locked in combat; it is embarked on a transport; or it includes at least one pinned or routed model.
Une unité ne peut passer en Réserves dep: A unit may only move into Reserves from the battlefield if a Special Rule allows it to, and in the manner that rule describes. In the core rules, only models with the Flyer Sub-type can do so (page 224 of the Age of Darkness Rulebook). As a general rule, models cannot "exit" the battlefield: reaching a table edge does not allow a model to move into Reserves.

Une Unité qui comprend au moins une Figu: A Unit that includes at least one Model equipped with a Misericordia may choose a unique Aftermath option, during which it makes a special attack against an enemy Unit involved in the same Combat: "The Blade of Mercy", which may be chosen during Step 4 of the Resolution Sub-Phase of the Assault Phase for any Combat that ended in a victory or a draw for the Unit. The Controlling Player chooses a single Model equipped with a Misericordia in that Unit, with which they resolve Steps 4 to 10 of the Resolve an Initiative Step sequence, targeting an enemy Unit involved in the Combat for which the Fall Back Aftermath option was chosen. These attacks use the following profile: IM 1, AM 1, SM (normal Strength), AP 3, Precision (2+), Breaching (5+), Power Trait; the Damage Characteristic of this Melee Weapon is equal to the number of Models equipped with a Misericordia in the Unit for which this Aftermath option was chosen.
Une unité qui comprend des figurines aya: A unit that includes models with the Routed status (see Tactical Statuses) must Fall Back during this final sub-phase, unless it is Locked in Combat.
Une Unité qui compte au moins une Figuri: A Unit that includes at least one Model with this Special Rule gains the Malefic Sub-type and the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule as soon as it scores Victory Points by virtue of the Vanguard (X) Special Rule, after suffering D3 Wounds. A Unit that includes Models with this Special Rule can never be joined by a Model that does not have it. In addition, the first time in a Battle that a Unit including Models with this Special Rule scores Victory Points by virtue of the Vanguard (X) Special Rule, that Unit immediately suffers D3 automatic Wounds with an AP of 2 and a Damage of 1, against which no Saves may be made. Once these Wounds have been resolved, all Models in that Unit immediately gain the Malefic Sub-type and the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule for the rest of the Battle.

A Unit that includes at least one Model with this Special Rule never gains the Routed Tactical Status for suffering 25% or more Casualties in the Shooting Phase. A Unit that includes at least one Model with this Special Rule never has to make a Leadership Check in the Morale Sub-Phase to avoid gaining the Routed Tactical Status as a result of a number of Models from that Unit being Removed as Casualties by a single Shooting Attack.

A Unit that includes at least one Model with this Special Rule can never be used to choose a Prime Advantage. When a Unit that includes at least one Model with this Special Rule is selected to fill a Supreme Force Organisation Slot, no corresponding Prime Advantage may be chosen.

A Unit that includes at least one Model with this Special Rule may have a unique Aftermath option chosen for it that forces any enemy Unit with at least one Model within 8" to take a Panic Check. In Step 4 of the Resolution Sub-Phase, the Player who won the Combat must choose this Aftermath option for any Unit in that Combat composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule; a Unit only partially composed of such Models may instead make a Cool Check, choosing another Aftermath option if it is passed. The Thirst: a Leadership Check is immediately made for each enemy Unit that is not involved in the Combat and has at least one Model within 8" of one or more Models in this Unit. If that Check is failed, all Models in that enemy Unit gain the Routed Tactical Status. This Aftermath option is resolved after all other Aftermath options in that Combat.

Vastes au-delà de toute compréhension, l: Vast beyond all comprehension, the greatest daemonic monstrosities dominate the battlefield. Even the slightest blow of their limbs can shatter a tank, and the pounding of their footsteps crushes infantry like ants. In battle, they advance like animated siege towers, compulsive monsters determined to breach the enemy's defences. Their considerable size makes them the favoured target of the heavy artillery of the armies that face them, and only concentrated barrage fire can bring them down — and even then the vile energy of the Warp guarantees only a temporary respite from their inexorable assault.
